questions.title: Strict typing
questions.question: A controller passes "42" to a function accepting int. How does strict_types affect this call, and where must it be declared?
questions.lesson: PHP dynamically typed، لكن تقدر تحدد types للـparameters والـreturn values. strict_types بيتحكم في scalar coercion حسب ملف الاستدعاء، ومش بديل عن validation لبيانات الـrequest.
questions.model: Declare strict_types=1 in the calling file. Passing a numeric string to an int parameter then throws TypeError; a coercive caller may convert it. PHP remains dynamically typed. Validate external input separately. An int is accepted for a float parameter.
questions.pitfall: strict_types مش بيحوّل PHP إلى statically typed language، ومكان تعريف الدالة لوحده مش كفاية.

questions.title: Comparison pitfalls
questions.question: An API returns status as "0". Explain the risk of == and empty(), and how you would check a required field.
questions.lesson: في PHP كل قيمة لها شيئان: القيمة نفسها، ونوعها. على سبيل المثال 0 من نوع integer، بينما "0" من نوع string رغم أن الاثنين يبدوان كصفر. عند استخدام == يجري PHP مقارنة مرنة: إذا كان النوعان مختلفين فقد يحوّل أحدهما تلقائيًا قبل المقارنة، وهذا يسمى type juggling. لذلك قد تحصل على true في حالات لم تقصد اعتبارها متساوية. أما === فهي مقارنة صارمة؛ لا تعيد true إلا عندما تتساوى القيمة والنوع معًا، ولذلك 0 === "0" نتيجتها false. الدالة empty() لا تسأل هل الحقل موجود فقط، بل تسأل هل يعتبر PHP قيمته فارغة، وPHP يعتبر "0" قيمة فارغة. لهذا قد ترفض empty() قيمة صحيحة في نظامك، مثل status أو quantity مسموح أن يساوي صفرًا. إذا كنت تريد معرفة هل المفتاح أُرسل فاستخدم array_key_exists، ثم تحقق من نوع القيمة ومن القيم المسموحة بشكل صريح.
questions.plainExplanation: تخيّل أن القيمة لها بطاقة مكتوب عليها المحتوى والنوع. الرقم 0 بطاقته integer، أما النص "0" فبطاقته string. العامل == قد يتجاهل اختلاف البطاقة ويحاول تحويل القيم قبل المقارنة، لكن === يفحص المحتوى والبطاقة معًا. وempty() لها قائمة خاصة من القيم التي تعتبرها فارغة، ومن ضمنها النص "0"؛ لذلك ليست مناسبة للتحقق من أن حقلًا مطلوبًا موجود عندما يكون الصفر قيمة مقبولة.
questions.practicalExample: API ترسل status="0" للدلالة على حالة صحيحة. الكود if (empty($data['status'])) سيرفض الطلب مع أن القيمة موجودة. الأفضل أولًا استخدام array_key_exists('status', $data)، ثم التحقق أن status واحدة من القيم المسموحة، مع تحويل النوع بشكل مقصود إذا كان عقد الـAPI يسمح بذلك.
questions.model: Use === when type matters. empty("0") is true, so it can reject valid zero values. Use array_key_exists for key presence, distinguish null with an explicit check, and validate the accepted domain rather than relying on truthiness.
questions.pitfall: isset بيرجع false لو المفتاح موجود وقيمته null؛ array_key_exists بيجاوب على وجود المفتاح نفسه.

questions.title: Exceptions at the boundary
questions.question: A payment SDK throws an exception. How do you handle it without exposing internals to the client?
questions.lesson: امسك الـexception في المكان اللي تقدر تتصرف فيه. سجّل context مفيد من غير secrets، ورجّع response مفهوم. متبلعش الخطأ وترجع success.
questions.model: Catch the specific SDK exception at the integration boundary, map it to a domain error and an appropriate HTTP response, report sanitized context with a correlation ID, and let unexpected failures reach the global handler. Retry only transient failures with idempotency.
questions.pitfall: catch (Throwable) وبعدين return true بيخفي الفشل وبيبوّظ الـobservability.

questions.title: Arrays and key coercion
questions.question: What happens to keys "1", 1, true and "01" in a PHP array? How would you model external identifiers safely?
questions.lesson: PHP array عبارة عن ordered map. بعض numeric string keys بتتحول لـint، وbool key بيتحوّل لـ0 أو1. ده ممكن يسبب overwrite من غير ما تقصد.
questions.model: The keys "1", 1 and true all address integer key 1, so later writes overwrite that entry. "01" remains a string key. Preserve external IDs as values or prefix map keys. Test collisions and do not assume arrays are simple lists.
questions.pitfall: array key casting مختلف عن مجرد مقارنة === بين قيمتين.

questions.title: Array merge versus union
questions.question: Compare array_merge and the + union operator when merging configuration with numeric and duplicate string keys.
questions.lesson: array_merge بيعيد ترقيم numeric keys وبيخلي آخر string key يكسب. Union + بيحتفظ بمفاتيح اليسار، بما فيها numeric keys. اختار حسب معنى الـdata.
questions.model: array_merge appends and reindexes numeric keys; later string keys overwrite earlier ones. The union operator preserves keys from the left operand and adds only missing keys from the right. Test both duplicate string and numeric keys; neither is a universal deep-merge strategy.
questions.pitfall: دمج nested config محتاج policy واضحة؛ مش كل merge recursive بيحقق الـoverride المطلوب.

questions.title: References in foreach
questions.question: Why can a foreach by reference corrupt a later loop, and how do you prevent it?
questions.lesson: foreach ($items as &$item) بيسيب $item ماسك reference لآخر عنصر بعد انتهاء الـloop. افصل الـreference قبل إعادة استخدام الاسم، أو تجنّب الـreference أصلاً.
questions.model: After a reference foreach, the loop variable still references the last element. A later assignment or by-value foreach using that variable may overwrite it. Call unset($item) immediately after the reference loop or transform values without references. Add a regression test of the resulting array.
questions.pitfall: الـscope بتاع foreach مش block scope منفصل في PHP.

questions.title: Value semantics and objects
questions.question: Assign an array and an object to another variable, then mutate each. Explain the different outcomes.
questions.lesson: Array assignment له value semantics مع copy-on-write. Object assignment بينسخ object identifier؛ الاتنين بيشيروا لنفس الـobject، لكن ده مش نفس مفهوم PHP & reference.
questions.model: Arrays behave as values; copy-on-write avoids an eager full copy until needed. Assigning an object copies its object identifier, so property changes are visible through both variables. clone creates a shallow clone; nested objects remain shared unless explicitly cloned. Distinguish object sharing from & references.
questions.pitfall: clone مش deep copy تلقائي للـobject graph.

questions.title: Closures and arrow functions
questions.question: A closure captures $rate, then $rate changes. Compare use ($rate), use (&$rate), and an arrow function.
questions.lesson: Closure العادية بتختار المتغيرات في use. Capture by value بياخد القيمة وقت إنشاء الـclosure. Arrow functions بتعمل implicit capture by value للـouter variables.
questions.model: use ($rate) captures the value when the closure is created; use (&$rate) observes changes through a reference. An arrow function implicitly captures by value. For objects, by-value capture still carries an identifier to the same object; prefer explicit, side-effect-free calculations for pricing.
questions.pitfall: by-value capture للـobject مش معناه نسخة مستقلة من حالته.

questions.title: Generators and memory
questions.question: Process a 2 GB CSV in PHP without loading every row. Where does yield help, and what can still exhaust memory?
questions.lesson: Generator بيطلع قيمة عند الطلب ويحافظ على state التنفيذ. لازم مصدر البيانات نفسه يبقى streaming؛ yield بعد file() مش هيصلّح إن الملف اتحمّل كله.
questions.model: Read incrementally with fopen and fgetcsv, yielding one validated row at a time. Close the resource in finally. Keep downstream consumers incremental and avoid iterator_to_array or retaining every result. Measure peak memory; yield does not undo an eager load performed earlier.
questions.pitfall: متخزنش النتائج كلها في array لو هدفك أصلًا bounded memory.

questions.title: Null handling
questions.question: An update payload may omit nickname, contain null, or contain "". How do you preserve these three meanings?
questions.lesson: Missing ممكن معناها متغيّرش القيمة، null امسحها، وempty string قيمة مستقلة حسب contract. ?? بيجمع missing وnull في حالة واحدة؛ ده مش دايمًا المطلوب.
questions.model: Use array_key_exists to distinguish omission from a present null. Validate whether null and empty string are allowed, account for middleware converting empty strings to null, and update only supplied keys. Document PATCH semantics and test all three states; ?? alone cannot distinguish them.
questions.pitfall: Laravel middleware ممكن يعمل TrimStrings وConvertEmptyStringsToNull قبل validation.

questions.title: match and enums
questions.question: Refactor status branching using a backed enum and match. What happens with an unexpected external value?
questions.lesson: match بيستخدم strict comparison ويرجع value ومفيهوش fall-through. Backed enum بيحدد قيم مسموحة؛ tryFrom مناسب للـuntrusted values بدل افتراض إنها صحيحة.
questions.model: Parse the external scalar with Status::tryFrom and handle null as invalid input. match compares strictly and must cover the runtime value or throws UnhandledMatchError without a matching arm or default. Prefer explicit handling so a newly added case is reviewed; test invalid values and every supported state.
questions.pitfall: Enum يحدّد الحالات، لكنه مش بيضمن إن الانتقال من pending لـrefunded مسموح business-wise.

questions.title: Exceptions and finally
questions.question: A file import throws halfway through. Where should cleanup happen, and what is risky about return in finally?
questions.lesson: finally بينفّذ cleanup سواء حصل exception أو لأ في flow العادي. return جواه ممكن يطغى على نتيجة أو exception من try، فخلّيه للـcleanup فقط.
questions.model: Acquire the resource, process within try, catch only errors you can meaningfully handle, and close in finally. Avoid returning from finally because it can override a return or suppress a pending exception. Preserve the original failure, log sanitized context and test both success and failure paths.
questions.pitfall: متفترضش finally هيحصل في كل انهيار للعملية زي kill قسري.

questions.title: DateTimeImmutable
questions.question: A billing date is shared by multiple calculations. Why might mutable DateTime introduce bugs?
questions.lesson: DateTime::modify بيغيّر نفس الـobject. DateTimeImmutable بيرجع object جديد. خزن timezone بوضوح وحدد قواعد نهاية الشهر والفروق بين تاريخ تقويمي ومدة بالثواني.
questions.model: Use DateTimeImmutable and assign the returned modified instance. Store instants consistently, commonly UTC, and convert at display boundaries. Define business timezone and end-of-month policy before adding months; test leap years, month ends and daylight-saving boundaries where relevant.
questions.pitfall: إضافة شهر لـ31 يناير مش لازم تنتج آخر يوم في فبراير تلقائيًا؛ دي business rule محتاجة تعريف.

questions.title: JSON failures
questions.question: A downstream API returns malformed JSON and big integer IDs. How would you decode safely?
questions.lesson: json_decode ممكن يرجّع null بسبب payload قيمته null أو بسبب error. JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR يفرّق الفشل، والـlarge IDs لازم تحافظ على دقتها حسب الـcontract.
questions.model: Decode with JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR and catch JsonException at the boundary. Validate the decoded shape, required fields and types. Use JSON_BIGINT_AS_STRING when integer identifiers may exceed supported integer range, or require IDs as strings in the contract. Distinguish a valid JSON null from malformed input.
questions.pitfall: نجاح JSON decode مش دليل إن الـdata مطابقة للـschema المطلوب.

questions.title: Money and numeric precision
questions.question: Why can 0.1 + 0.2 fail an exact money comparison? Design a reliable amount representation.
questions.lesson: Floating point بيمثل كسور ثنائية تقريبية. استخدم integer minor units أو decimal library مناسب وحدد currency scale وrounding rule، بدل إضافة epsilon عشوائي للفلوس.
questions.model: Represent money with integer minor units where the currency scale permits, or exact decimal arithmetic. Carry currency with the amount, define rounding at explicit boundaries and reject mixed-currency operations. Check overflow and test rounding, refunds and zero-decimal currencies; do not compare floating amounts for equality.
questions.pitfall: مش كل العملات فيها خانتين عشريتين، ومش كل monetary calculation ينفع يتعمل بـinteger من غير rounding policy.

questions.title: Readonly and invariants
questions.question: Does a readonly property containing an object make that nested object immutable? How do you protect a value object?
questions.lesson: readonly بيمنع إعادة تعيين الـproperty بعد initialization، لكنه مش deep immutability لحالة object متخزن جواه. Value object محتاج invariant واضح وسلوك من غير mutation خارجي.
questions.model: No: a readonly object property can still refer to a mutable object whose internal state changes. Prefer immutable nested values, validate invariants in construction, avoid exposing mutable references and return new values for transformations. Test invalid construction and attempted state changes; readonly alone is not deep immutability.
questions.pitfall: readonly مش بديل عن تصميم immutable objects.

questions.title: Named arguments and compatibility
questions.question: A package renames a method parameter used by callers as a named argument. Can that break consumers?
questions.lesson: Named arguments بتربط الاستدعاء باسم الـparameter، فالأسماء بقت جزء مهم من public API بالنسبة للمستهلكين. تغيير الاسم ممكن يكسر كود حتى لو الـtypes ثابتة.
questions.model: Yes. A call using the old parameter name can fail with an unknown named parameter. Treat public parameter names as part of compatibility, preserve names where practical, use a migration/deprecation policy and test named as well as positional calls. Avoid blind spreading of untrusted associative arrays into calls.
questions.pitfall: تغيير parameter name مش refactor داخلي آمن دايمًا في public library.

questions.title: String encoding
questions.question: A user’s Arabic name is truncated incorrectly by substr. How do you handle Unicode and user-perceived characters?
questions.lesson: PHP string عبارة عن bytes. mb_* بتتعامل مع encoding زي UTF-8، لكن grapheme clusters زي بعض emoji محتاجة grapheme-aware operations. اختبر العربي والـcombining characters.
questions.model: Specify UTF-8 throughout input, storage and output. Use mb_substr for multibyte code points and grapheme_substr when the requirement is user-perceived characters and intl is available. Validate encoding, avoid byte-length assumptions and test Arabic text, combining marks and emoji sequences.
questions.pitfall: عدد bytes مش هو عدد الحروف اللي المستخدم شايفها.

questions.title: Sessions and password hashes
questions.question: Why is hashing a password different from encrypting a session payload?
questions.lesson: Hashing للـpassword اتجاه واحد مع cost مناسب. Encryption قابلة للعكس بمفتاح وتحتاج integrity protection؛ sessions كمان ليها lifecycle وcookie security.
questions.model: Use password_hash and password_verify or framework Hash APIs for passwords, with rehash checks when policy changes. Use authenticated encryption for reversible data and manage keys securely. Rotate session IDs after authentication and set secure cookie attributes; never store plaintext passwords or reversible password encryption.
questions.pitfall: SHA-256 لوحده مش password hashing scheme مناسب بسبب سرعته.

questions.title: Iterables and type contracts
questions.question: A function accepts iterable. What may it receive and why might counting or iterating twice be unsafe?
questions.lesson: iterable يشمل array وTraversable. مش كل iterable قابل لإعادة القراءة أو count؛ generator استهلاكه له lifecycle وممكن ميكونش rewindable زي array.
questions.model: Accept arrays and Traversable implementations. Process in one pass unless the contract explicitly guarantees replayability. Do not assume count works on any iterable; use Countable only when appropriate. Materialize deliberately if repeated access is required and memory is bounded, and test with a generator as well as an array.
questions.pitfall: iterable contract مش وعد بـrandom access أو size معروف.

questions.title: Union and intersection types
questions.question: Compare Foo|Bar, Foo&Bar and ?Foo. How do you model a missing value without hiding invalid input?
questions.lesson: Union بيقبل واحد من types؛ intersection محتاج object يحقق كل types؛ nullable بيسمح null. Type declarations مش schema validation لكل محتويات array.
questions.model: Foo|Bar accepts either type; Foo&Bar requires the relevant object contracts simultaneously; ?Foo means Foo|null. Choose the narrowest truthful contract, validate array shapes separately and distinguish missing from null at input boundaries. Test valid alternatives and invalid/null cases rather than defaulting everything to mixed.
questions.pitfall: array type لوحدها مش بتفرض key names أو types لكل item؛ annotations/static analysis تساعد بجانب runtime validation.

questions.title: Magic methods and hidden behavior
questions.question: A model helper uses __get and __call to make every operation dynamic. What are the maintainability risks?
questions.lesson: Magic methods مفيدة في frameworks لكن ممكن تخفي dependencies وtypos وتضعّف discoverability. Public contracts وtype information لازم يفضلوا واضحين.
questions.model: Use explicit methods/properties for business contracts and reserve magic dispatch for well-defined framework boundaries. Provide accurate type metadata, reject unknown operations and avoid hidden I/O in property reads. Test behavior and error paths; magic methods do not replace intentional encapsulation or make arbitrary calls safe.
questions.pitfall: Model property access ممكن يطلق lazy-loading query؛ شكل الكود البسيط مش proof إن مفيش I/O.

questions.title: Dependency inversion
questions.question: CheckoutService directly creates StripeGateway. Refactor it so a fake gateway can be used in tests.
questions.lesson: DIP معناه الـhigh-level business logic يعتمد على abstraction. DI هي طريقة تمرير الاعتماد، والـContainer يقدر يركّب الـobjects بدل new جوه الـservice.
questions.model: Inject PaymentGateway through the constructor. StripeGateway and FakeGateway implement the contract. Bind the interface to StripeGateway in a service provider and override the binding with the fake in tests. CheckoutService depends on the contract, not a vendor.
questions.pitfall: استخدام Container::make داخل كل method بيخفي dependencies؛ constructor injection أوضح.

questions.title: Single responsibility
questions.question: A controller validates orders, calculates discounts, charges cards and sends emails. Where should each responsibility live?
questions.lesson: SRP بيهتم بأسباب التغيير، مش عدد الـmethods. الـController يستقبل الطلب وينسّق؛ business rules ليها مكان واضح ومش لازم تعمل class لكل سطر.
questions.model: Use a FormRequest for validation and authorization, an application service to coordinate checkout, a pricing component for discounts, a gateway for charging, and a queued notification after commit. Keep the controller thin and test business rules separately.
questions.pitfall: نقل كل حاجة من Controller لـService عملاق بيغيّر الاسم بس، مش بيحل تداخل المسؤوليات.

questions.title: Liskov substitution
questions.question: A ReadOnlyRepository extends a writable repository but throws on save(). Which principle is violated and how do you redesign it?
questions.lesson: LSP معناه البديل يحافظ على contract السلوك، مش بس method signature. ISP يساعدك تفصل contracts حسب الاحتياج.
questions.model: The subtype breaks LSP because clients expecting save cannot use it safely. Split read and write contracts following ISP; the read-only implementation only implements the read contract. Inject the smallest contract each client needs and test behavioral guarantees.
questions.pitfall: وجود نفس أسماء الـmethods مش معناه إن الـobjects قابلة للاستبدال بأمان.

questions.title: Encapsulation and invariants
questions.question: An Order exposes public status and total properties. How can you prevent invalid changes?
questions.lesson: Encapsulation هدفها حماية invariants. بدل setters عشوائية، اعرض operations زي cancel وpay تتحقق من قواعد التحول والحالة.
questions.model: Keep mutable state private, validate construction and expose domain operations such as pay or cancel. Reject invalid transitions, derive totals from trusted line items and return read-only views or values. Persist atomically and test forbidden transitions; getters/setters alone do not enforce invariants.
questions.pitfall: تحويل public property إلى setter بيقبل أي قيمة مش حماية حقيقية.

questions.title: Open/closed principle
questions.question: DiscountService is edited for every campaign. Apply OCP without introducing an unnecessary plugin framework.
questions.lesson: OCP بيشجع إضافة behavior جديد من خلال extension points ثابتة. حدد Variation الحقيقي؛ مش كل if يبقى design smell.
questions.model: Extract a DiscountPolicy contract and compose applicable rules through a small resolver. Add a policy implementation for a genuinely different algorithm and test ordering and conflicts. Keep stable coordination unchanged while avoiding abstraction for trivial, unchanging conditions.
questions.pitfall: OCP مش معناه الكود ممنوع يتعدل أو إن كل حالة محتاجة inheritance.

questions.title: Interface segregation
questions.question: A reporting client depends on Repository with export, save, delete and sync. It only reads. Redesign the contract.
questions.lesson: ISP بيفصل interfaces حسب اللي الـclients محتاجاه. Small interface مفيد لما يعكس دور فعلي، مش تقسيم اعتباطي لكل method.
questions.model: Introduce a query-focused ReadRepository or reporting query contract, with write and sync capabilities in separate role-based interfaces. Inject only the required read contract into the reporter. Preserve consistent semantics and test implementations without forcing unsupported methods or dummy exceptions.
questions.pitfall: ترمي UnsupportedOperation من نصف interface معناها غالبًا الـcontract أوسع من احتياج الـimplementation.

questions.title: Composition versus inheritance
questions.question: A PremiumUser extends User only to change discount logic. What are the design alternatives?
questions.lesson: Inheritance لازم تحافظ على is-a وbehavioral contract. لو الخصم بيتغير مستقل عن user، composition بتقلل coupling وclass hierarchy.
questions.model: Prefer composing a DiscountPolicy or customer tier value when pricing varies independently from identity. Use inheritance only with a valid substitutable relationship and stable behavior. Inject policies, test tier transitions and avoid a subclass for every combination of features.
questions.pitfall: زيادة combinations من subclasses علامة إن composition ممكن تكون أنسب.

questions.title: Static methods and testability
questions.question: A service calls static Clock::now and global config. How would you make its tests deterministic?
questions.lesson: Dependency واضحة زي Clock contract بتخلي الاختبار يحدد الوقت بدل الاعتماد على global state. مش كل static method غلط؛ pure utilities حالة مختلفة.
questions.model: Inject a Clock and explicit configuration values or a configuration object. Use a fixed clock in unit tests and test boundary times. Keep pure static utilities where appropriate, but avoid hidden mutable global dependencies in business logic. Reset or isolate any unavoidable global test state.
questions.pitfall: Laravel Facade مش مجرد static helper؛ هو proxy لservice في الـContainer، وده له testing tools مختلفة.

questions.title: Runtime polymorphism
questions.question: How can two objects with the same payment contract behave differently without instanceof checks in CheckoutService?
questions.lesson: Polymorphism بيخلّي المستهلك ينادي نفس contract، والـimplementation يحدد السلوك. لو المستهلك بيفحص النوع في كل خطوة، غالبًا abstraction بتسرّب تفاصيل.
questions.model: Accept the PaymentGateway contract and call its operation; runtime method dispatch chooses the concrete implementation. Keep vendor branching in a resolver/adapter boundary, preserve result/error semantics and share contract tests. Polymorphism is about substitutable behavior, not merely two classes having similar method names.
questions.pitfall: استخدام instanceof لكل provider جوه business flow بيقلل قيمة الـcontract.

questions.title: Constructor invariants and lifecycle
questions.question: A subclass overrides its constructor and assumes the parent constructor still runs. What happens in PHP?
questions.lesson: لو subclass عرّفت constructor، لازم تنادي parent::__construct صراحة لو تهيئة الأب مطلوبة. خليك حذر من استدعاء overridable methods أثناء بناء object لسه ناقص.
questions.model: The child constructor overrides construction and must explicitly call parent::__construct when parent initialization is required. Establish invariants before exposing behavior, avoid calling overridable methods on partially initialized objects and test both base and subclass construction. Prefer composition if construction contracts become incompatible.
questions.pitfall: Dependency Injection مش معناه إن constructor يبدأ network calls أو workflow كامل قبل استخدام الخدمة.

questions.title: What is abstraction?
questions.question: Explain abstraction using a payment checkout example. Is abstraction the same thing as a PHP interface?
questions.lesson: Abstraction مفهوم: تظهر السلوك اللي المحتاج للكود يهمه وتخفي تفاصيل التنفيذ. Interface أداة لتحديد contract، ومش هي المفهوم كله؛ abstract class أو public API ممكن يحققوا abstraction.
questions.model: Abstraction exposes essential behavior while hiding implementation details. Checkout calls charge without knowing HTTP authentication or vendor payloads. A PHP interface can express that contract, but abstraction is a design concept also achievable through classes and APIs.
questions.pitfall: Abstraction وInterface مش مترادفين: الأول مفهوم تصميم، والتاني construct في اللغة.

questions.title: Interface or abstract class?
questions.question: Two gateways share retry logic but have different charge implementations. When would you use an interface, an abstract class, or composition?
questions.lesson: Interface يحدد contract. Abstract class يقدر يشيل shared implementation وstate، لكن PHP بيسمح بـsingle class inheritance. Composition بيسمح تركّب retry policy مستقلة.
questions.model: Keep a PaymentGateway interface for consumers. An abstract base may share implementation if there is a stable is-a relationship, but PHP allows only one parent class. Prefer composing a RetryPolicy when retry behavior varies independently; implementations can satisfy multiple interfaces.
questions.pitfall: مش كل تكرار يستاهل inheritance؛ اسأل الأول هل العلاقة is-a فعلًا؟

questions.title: Contract compatibility
questions.question: A gateway implementation narrows charge(float $amount) to charge(int $amount). Is that a valid implementation?
questions.lesson: الـimplementation لازم يقبل على الأقل كل المدخلات المسموحة في contract. Parameter types ينفع تتوسّع contravariance، والـreturn type ينفع يتخصص covariance.
questions.model: No. Narrowing the parameter rejects values allowed by the interface and is incompatible. Parameter types may be contravariant and return types covariant. Keep float or use an appropriate wider parameter type; model money explicitly rather than relying on floating-point arithmetic.
questions.pitfall: الأموال غالبًا تتمثل بـinteger minor units أو decimal مناسب؛ float مش اختيار آمن للحسابات المالية.

questions.title: Implement multiple contracts
questions.question: Can a PHP class implement multiple interfaces while extending two abstract classes? Explain the design constraint.
questions.lesson: PHP بيسمح للـclass يـimplement أكتر من interface، لكن يمتد من class واحدة. Traits لإعادة استخدام methods، مش بديل تلقائي للـcontracts.
questions.model: A class may implement multiple compatible interfaces but extends only one class, abstract or concrete. Use composition for independent implementations and traits for carefully scoped reuse. Resolve contract signature compatibility and do not treat a trait as a type consumers can require.
questions.pitfall: Traits مش multiple inheritance للـobject type hierarchy.

questions.title: Abstract class lifecycle
questions.question: An abstract exporter defines export() and requires formatRows(). How would Template Method work here?
questions.lesson: Abstract class ممكن تحدد flow ثابت وتسيب hook methods للتخصيص. خليك واضح في ترتيب الخطوات وما تفتحش override لحاجات لازم تحافظ على invariant.
questions.model: The base exporter implements the stable workflow and calls a protected abstract formatRows hook. A final orchestration method can protect ordering when needed. Keep extension points small, test each formatter and choose composition if workflow steps need to vary independently at runtime.
questions.pitfall: Template Method بيعتمد على inheritance؛ Strategy بيبدّل behavior عن طريق composition.

questions.title: Contract behavioral guarantees
questions.question: Two gateway implementations share a signature, but one returns before payment confirmation and the other after settlement. Is that enough?
questions.lesson: Contract محتاج semantics: الـreturn معناه إيه، الأخطاء إيه، وهل العملية pending ولا confirmed. مطابقة types لوحدها مش ضمان للسلوك.
questions.model: No. Define whether the result is pending, authorized, captured or settled, plus error and retry semantics. Model those states explicitly rather than a vague boolean. Use contract tests shared across adapters and let application workflows handle asynchronous confirmation consistently.
questions.pitfall: charge(): bool ممكن يخبّي فروق مهمة بين providers.

questions.title: DTO versus domain object
questions.question: Should a DTO enforce the entire order workflow, or simply represent data crossing a boundary?
questions.lesson: DTO بينقل data بشكل واضح، وممكن يتحقق من shape أساسية. Domain object يحمي business invariants والسلوك؛ الاتنين أدوار مختلفة حتى لو فيهم نفس fields.
questions.model: Use a DTO for explicit boundary input/output with validated types and minimal mapping concerns. Keep state transitions and cross-field business invariants in domain objects or application actions as appropriate. Avoid leaking HTTP Request or Eloquent internals into all layers and test mapping separately from business behavior.
questions.pitfall: DTO اسم class مش architecture في حد ذاته؛ دورها وحدودها هم المهمين.

questions.title: Contract evolution
questions.question: You add refund() to a PaymentGateway interface with ten implementations. How do you avoid breaking unsupported gateways?
questions.lesson: توسيع interface بيجبر implementations على contract جديد. Capability interface زي RefundGateway أو adapter versioning ممكن يحافظ على وضوح الدعم بدل throw مفاجئ.
questions.model: Model optional capabilities with a separate RefundGateway contract or an explicit supported-operation result and migration plan. Update consumers to require the capability they need, preserve existing charge semantics and run contract tests across implementations. Do not silently add an unsupported method with a fake success result.
questions.pitfall: Interface changes public API changes؛ متتعاملش معاها كتعديل داخلي بسيط.

questions.title: Trace a request
questions.question: Trace an HTTP request from public/index.php to the response. Where do providers and middleware fit?
questions.lesson: الـentry point بيحمّل autoloader ويجهّز التطبيق. الـframework بيعمل bootstrap ويسجّل ويشغّل providers، والطلب يعدّي من middleware للـrouter والـcontroller ثم response يرجع عكس الـpipeline.
questions.model: public/index.php loads the autoloader and application bootstrap. The HTTP handling pipeline bootstraps the framework, registers then boots service providers, runs middleware, resolves the route and controller through the container, and sends the response back through middleware.
questions.pitfall: register للـbindings؛ boot للتهيئة بعد تسجيل الـproviders. تجنّب تنفيذ business workflow أثناء bootstrap.

questions.title: Service container resolution
questions.question: Why can Laravel resolve a concrete service automatically but fail to resolve PaymentGatewayInterface?
questions.lesson: الـContainer يقدر يستخدم reflection عشان يبني concrete dependencies. الـinterface مفيهاش implementation يختاره، فلازم binding. انتبه للـsingleton لو التطبيق long-lived.
questions.model: Concrete classes can often be auto-resolved through reflection when their dependencies are resolvable. An interface needs an explicit binding in a provider. Use bind for transient resolution, singleton for shared lifetime, or scoped for a request/job lifecycle when appropriate.
questions.pitfall: متخزّنش user-specific state في singleton جوه long-lived workers.

questions.title: Middleware and authorization
questions.question: An authenticated user requests another tenant’s invoice. Where do you enforce access and why is auth middleware insufficient?
questions.lesson: Authentication بيحدد مين المستخدم. Authorization بيحدد مسموح له يعمل إيه على الـresource ده. tenant scoping مهم في query والـpolicy مع بعض.
questions.model: Authentication only identifies the user. Resolve the invoice within the tenant scope and enforce an InvoicePolicy for the action. Do not trust a tenant_id supplied by the client. Return the appropriate 403 or 404 and test cross-tenant access.
questions.pitfall: وجود auth middleware مش تصريح تلقائي إن المستخدم يقدر يشوف كل records.

questions.title: Configuration and environment
questions.question: Why can env("PAYMENT_KEY") work locally but return unexpected results after config:cache?
questions.lesson: خلي env calls في config files واستخدم config في runtime. بعد config caching التطبيق بيقرأ الـconfiguration المجمّعة بدل افتراض تحميل .env بنفس الشكل.
questions.model: Read environment values inside config files and consume config("services.payment.key") in application code. Build or refresh configuration cache with the correct runtime environment, never commit secrets, and restart long-lived workers when configuration changes. Verify deployment configuration rather than calling env throughout services.
questions.pitfall: config:cache على بيئة غلط ممكن يثبت قيم غلط داخل build؛ متتعاملش مع config cache كأنه secret store.

questions.title: Facade versus DI
questions.question: How does a Laravel Facade differ from a real static method, and when is constructor injection clearer?
questions.lesson: Facade بتوفّر syntax static لكن بتوصل لـservice resolved من الـContainer. DI بتخلي الاعتماد ظاهر في constructor ومفيدة في domain code والـtests.
questions.model: A Facade proxies calls to an underlying container-resolved instance, so it can support framework mocking/swapping unlike a normal static method. Constructor injection makes dependencies explicit and portable. Choose based on context, avoid hidden service location everywhere and test the service behavior rather than the facade syntax.
questions.pitfall: Facades مش دليل إن الخدمة pure static أو عديمة state.

questions.title: Scoped state in workers
questions.question: A singleton stores the current tenant. What can go wrong under a long-lived worker and how do you fix it?
questions.lesson: Long-lived workers بيخلوا process يعيش بين requests أو jobs. mutable singleton ممكن يسرّب state بين tenants لو مفيش reset مضمون.
questions.model: Do not retain request-specific tenant state in process-wide singletons. Pass tenant context explicitly or use appropriate scoped bindings and framework lifecycle cleanup. Audit static caches and listeners, test sequential requests for different tenants on the same worker and restart workers on deployment.
questions.pitfall: الـcode الآمن في PHP-FPM request isolation مش لازم يبقى آمن بنفس الشكل في Octane أو queue workers.

questions.title: Sanctum choices
questions.question: For a first-party SPA and a mobile client, how would you choose between Sanctum cookie authentication and API tokens?
questions.lesson: اختيار auth مرتبط بالـclient. First-party SPA ممكن تستخدم session cookies مع CSRF؛ mobile غالبًا bearer tokens. CORS مش authorization.
questions.model: Use Sanctum stateful session cookies for a first-party SPA with configured stateful domains, credentialed requests and CSRF protection. Use bearer tokens for mobile, protect transport with HTTPS, restrict abilities and enforce policies. CORS controls browser access, not resource authorization.
questions.pitfall: تخزين long-lived tokens في browser storage يزود أثر XSS؛ والـtoken abilities متغنيش عن policies.

questions.title: API resource and errors
questions.question: Design the response contract for paginated orders and validation failures. How do you avoid leaking internal fields?
questions.lesson: API Resource يفصل response contract عن model internals. Pagination ضرورية للقوائم الكبيرة. validation errors ليها شكل ثابت والـclient يقدر يتعامل معاها.
questions.model: Use OrderResource with an explicit field allowlist and conditional relationships. Return pagination data and links/meta, choose cursor pagination for suitable large ordered datasets, and return 422 with field errors for validation failures. Document a stable error envelope and test the contract.
questions.pitfall: return Model مباشرة ممكن يكشف fields جديدة لما الـschema يتغير.

questions.title: Safe updates
questions.question: Two clients edit the same profile. How can an API detect a lost update rather than silently overwrite it?
questions.lesson: Lost update بتحصل لما طلب يكتب فوق تعديل طلب تاني بناءً على نسخة قديمة. Optimistic concurrency بيقارن version أو ETag بدل ما يمسك lock طويل.
questions.model: Return a version or ETag. Require the client to submit the expected version or If-Match, then atomically update only if it matches and increment the version. Reject a stale version with 409, or 412 for a failed If-Match precondition, and let the client reconcile.
questions.pitfall: قراءة version ثم update منفصل من غير شرط atomic بتسمح بنفس الـrace اللي بتحاول تمنعه.

questions.title: HTTP status and idempotency
questions.question: Compare PUT, PATCH and POST for a retrying client. Does an idempotent method guarantee that all side effects happen once?
questions.lesson: HTTP idempotency بتوصف intended effect لتكرار نفس request، مش عدد مرات logging أو network delivery. POST ممكن يبقى idempotent بتصميم خاص.
questions.model: PUT replaces a resource representation, PATCH applies partial changes, and POST commonly creates or triggers work. PUT is defined as idempotent; PATCH depends on the patch operation. Use idempotency keys for retry-sensitive actions and document response semantics. Method semantics alone do not ensure exactly-once execution.
questions.pitfall: عملية PATCH بتزود counter كل مرة مش idempotent تلقائيًا.

questions.title: Rate limiting
questions.question: Design rate limiting for login and an expensive report endpoint behind a proxy.
questions.lesson: Rate limit محتاج key مناسب زي user ID أو trusted IP، shared store بين servers، وresponse واضح. سياسة login تختلف عن reports الطويلة.
questions.model: Use endpoint-specific limits backed by a shared store. Key authenticated reports by user/tenant and protect login against both account and source abuse without enabling easy lockout attacks. Configure trusted proxies, return 429 with retry guidance and observe false positives and distributed abuse.
questions.pitfall: الاعتماد على X-Forwarded-For من أي client من غير trusted proxy configuration ممكن يسمح بتجاوز IP limits.

questions.title: API versioning
questions.question: A mobile app relies on an old response field. How do you rename it without breaking released clients?
questions.lesson: API versioning مش مجرد /v2؛ لازم compatibility plan وقياس استخدام النسخة القديمة وفترة deprecation واضحة.
questions.model: Prefer an additive transition: introduce the new field while preserving the old contract. Use an explicit API version when semantics must break, document deprecation and support windows, measure client usage and maintain contract tests for supported versions before removing fields.
questions.pitfall: الـmobile clients مش كلهم بيتحدّثوا في نفس يوم نشر الـbackend.

questions.title: Cursor pagination
questions.question: Why can offset pagination duplicate or skip items during frequent inserts? When is cursor pagination appropriate?
questions.lesson: Offset بيتأثر بتغيّر الصفوف قبل الـoffset. Cursor بيعتمد على stable ordering وunique tie-breaker، لكنه مش snapshot consistency ولا بديل لكل query.
questions.model: Use deterministic ordering such as created_at plus id. Cursor pagination continues relative to the last ordered tuple and avoids deep offsets for suitable indexed queries. Concurrent updates to ordering fields can still move records; define freshness requirements and test ties, deletions and inserts.
questions.pitfall: cursor من غير stable unique ordering ممكن يكرر أو يفوّت records برضه.

questions.title: API filtering and sort allowlists
questions.question: A list endpoint accepts sort_by and filter fields from the client. How do you prevent abuse?
questions.lesson: Query values ليها parameter binding، لكن SQL identifiers زي أسماء الأعمدة مش بتتأمّن لمجرد إن value parameterized. اعمل allowlist وقيود على query cost.
questions.model: Map allowed public sort/filter names to known columns and operators. Validate directions, types, lengths and page size, parameterize values, enforce tenant scope and index supported queries. Reject arbitrary SQL fragments and expensive unsupported combinations; test malicious and oversized input.
questions.pitfall: متبعتش client sort expression لـorderByRaw مباشرة.

questions.title: JWT validation
questions.question: A JWT payload contains role=admin. What must a backend validate before trusting any claim?
questions.lesson: JWT encoding مش encryption، وقراءة payload مش verification. لازم signature algorithm allowlist وissuer/audience/expiry وسياسة revocation مناسبة.
questions.model: Verify the signature with a trusted key and allowed algorithm, then validate issuer, audience, expiry and applicable time claims with controlled clock skew. Treat roles as claims subject to current authorization policy, protect tokens and define revocation/rotation. Never trust a decoded unsigned payload or allow the token to choose arbitrary verification behavior.
questions.pitfall: JWT مش لازم ولا أفضل من session في كل تطبيق؛ اختيار auth model مرتبط بالـclients والـthreat model.

questions.title: OAuth2 and OIDC
questions.question: Your app lets users sign in with an external identity provider. How do OAuth2, OIDC, state and PKCE fit?
questions.lesson: OAuth2 framework للتفويض، وOIDC بيضيف identity layer. استعمل library موثوقة وprovider flow مدعوم بدل اختراع token exchange.
questions.model: Use a supported authorization-code flow with PKCE as appropriate. Validate state and redirect URIs, and validate OIDC ID-token signature, issuer, audience and nonce when used. Store provider tokens securely, request minimum scopes and bind accounts safely; access tokens and ID tokens serve different purposes.
questions.pitfall: متربطش حسابين اعتمادًا على email claim غير متحقق من provenance والـverification policy.

questions.title: The N+1 problem
questions.question: An orders endpoint runs 101 queries for 100 orders while rendering customer names. Diagnose and fix it.
questions.lesson: Lazy loading داخل loop بيعمل query لكل علاقة. with بيعمل eager loading على مستوى الـquery. راقب query count والـmemory قبل وبعد، وخلي pagination جزء من الحل.
questions.model: This is N+1 from lazy-loading each customer. Fetch orders with with("customer") and paginate results; select required columns while retaining relationship keys. Measure query count and latency, enable lazy-loading prevention in development, and add a regression test.
questions.pitfall: Eager loading مش معناه ترجع كل records مرة واحدة؛ ده ممكن ينقل المشكلة للـmemory.

questions.title: Composite indexes
questions.question: A query filters tenant_id and status, then sorts by created_at. How do you evaluate an index?
questions.lesson: الـindex بيتصمم على queries حقيقية. ترتيب الأعمدة والـselectivity والـsort مهمين؛ مفيش index واحد مثالي لكل workload. الزيادة بتبطّأ writes وتاخد مساحة.
questions.model: Inspect EXPLAIN or EXPLAIN ANALYZE with production-like data. Consider (tenant_id, status, created_at) for equality filters followed by ordering. Compare examined rows and latency, account for selectivity and alternative queries, and balance read gains against write and storage cost.
questions.pitfall: إضافة index لكل عمود بشكل منفصل مش مكافئ بالضرورة للـcomposite index المناسب.

questions.title: Caching and invalidation
questions.question: Product prices are cached for five minutes. How do you keep checkout correct after a price change?
questions.lesson: Cache-aside مناسب للقراءات، لكن checkout لازم يستخدم مصدر موثوق ويثبت السعر للـorder. فكّر في invalidation بعد commit، والـstampede لما cache يخلص.
questions.model: Use cache-aside for catalog reads with scoped keys and TTL. Invalidate or version keys after a committed price change. Re-read authoritative pricing during checkout and store the accepted price on order lines. Mitigate stampedes with locks or stale-while-revalidate and monitor hit rate.
questions.pitfall: TTL لوحده مش ضمان لصحة سعر عملية دفع.

questions.title: Chunking while updating
questions.question: A backfill updates the same rows it is paging over. Why may chunk() miss rows and when would chunkById help?
questions.lesson: Offset pagination أثناء تعديل filter fields ممكن يزحزح النتائج. chunkById بيمشي على key بدل offset؛ اختار stable key ومتعدّلوش أثناء المرور.
questions.model: Use chunkById or lazyById on a stable unique key for this backfill. Capture boundaries or a checkpoint where needed, make each batch idempotent and use short transactions. Do not modify the cursor key; measure load and test inserts and restarts with the actual database.
questions.pitfall: chunkById مش snapshot ثابت لكل dataset، فلازم تحدد سياسة التعامل مع records الجديدة.

questions.title: Deadlocks
questions.question: Two transactions lock orders and inventory in opposite order. Diagnose a deadlock and design safe retries.
questions.lesson: Deadlock ممكن يحصل حتى لو الكود صحيح تحت concurrency. حافظ على consistent lock ordering وtransactions قصيرة، واعمل retry محدود للعملية كلها لما يكون آمن.
questions.model: Inspect database deadlock diagnostics. Acquire rows in a consistent order, keep transactions short and use suitable indexes to avoid broad scans. Retry the entire transaction with bounded backoff where safe, keep external side effects outside retries or idempotent, and load-test contention.
questions.pitfall: إعادة إرسال external charge جوه transaction اتعملها retry ممكن تسبب double charge.

questions.title: Isolation levels
questions.question: Can two SELECT queries inside one transaction observe different values? What determines that?
questions.lesson: Transaction مش معناها كل SELECT يشوف نفس snapshot في كل DB. Isolation level ونوع القراءة وengine semantics بيحددوا الـanomalies المسموحة.
questions.model: It depends on the database, isolation level and read type. READ COMMITTED may see newly committed data across statements; REPEATABLE READ often provides a consistent snapshot for ordinary reads, with engine-specific behavior for locks. Define the invariant, choose locking or conditional writes and test against the production engine.
questions.pitfall: متخلطش snapshot reads وlocking reads وتفترض إنهم دايمًا بيشوفوا نفس النسخة.

questions.title: Slow query investigation
questions.question: An endpoint is slow even though query count is low. What would you measure before changing code?
questions.lesson: عدد queries قليل مش معناه أداء كويس. ممكن query واحدة تعمل full scan أو sort تقيل، أو المشكلة serialization/network مش DB أصلًا.
questions.model: Break down p95 latency into database, network, application and serialization time. Inspect slow query plans, rows scanned, result size, index use and lock waits on representative data. Measure memory and external calls, change one bottleneck at a time and compare before/after metrics.
questions.pitfall: الـaverage لوحده بيخفي long-tail latency، وbenchmark على 10 rows مش ممثل للإنتاج.

questions.title: Soft deletes and uniqueness
questions.question: A soft-deleted user still blocks a unique email. Why, and what policy would you choose?
questions.lesson: Soft delete بيحط timestamp بدل حذف الصف. الـdatabase unique constraint لسه شايف الصف؛ تجاهله في validation مش كفاية لحل constraint conflict.
questions.model: Choose whether the identity remains reserved or can be reused. Align application validation and database constraints with that policy using an engine-supported strategy, and define restore conflicts. Test delete, re-registration and restore concurrently; do not assume adding nullable deleted_at to a unique index behaves uniformly.
questions.pitfall: NULL semantics في unique indexes تختلف حسب المحرك والتصميم؛ جرّب السلوك الحقيقي.

questions.title: Optimistic versus pessimistic locking
questions.question: Compare version-column updates and SELECT FOR UPDATE for low-contention versus highly contested records.
questions.lesson: Optimistic locking بيكتشف conflict وقت write؛ pessimistic بيقفل rows أثناء transaction. الاختيار حسب contention ووقت العملية وretry UX، مش واحد أفضل دائمًا.
questions.model: Use a version in an atomic conditional update to detect conflicts without holding a long lock, then surface or retry appropriately. Use row locks in short transactions when coordination is required under contention. Measure wait/deadlock rates and test both conflict paths; external effects still need idempotency.
questions.pitfall: قراءة version ثم update غير مشروط مش optimistic concurrency control صحيح.

questions.title: Connection pool pressure
questions.question: Why can scaling queue workers make the database slower even if CPU is not saturated?
questions.lesson: كل worker ممكن يفتح connection ويزود concurrency وlock contention. bottleneck ممكن يبقى connections أو I/O أو locks، مش CPU بس.
questions.model: Measure active connections, waits, transaction duration, I/O and query latency. Bound worker concurrency and batch size, optimize queries and use pooling compatible with the driver/deployment where needed. Apply backpressure and load-test; simply raising connection limits or worker count may worsen contention.
questions.pitfall: Read replicas مش هتقلل ضغط write transactions أو hot-row locks تلقائيًا.

questions.title: Duplicate webhooks
questions.question: A provider sends payment.succeeded three times, including concurrently. How do you prevent duplicate fulfillment?
questions.lesson: الـwebhook ممكن يتكرر ويتأخر ويوصل بترتيب مختلف. لازم verify signature وتخزن event ID بـunique constraint وتغيّر الحالة بشكل atomic.
questions.model: Verify the signature against the raw payload. Record the provider event ID with a unique constraint and handle the duplicate conflict. Atomically transition payment state and write an outbox record in a transaction. An idempotent consumer performs fulfillment; acknowledge quickly and retry transient failures.
questions.pitfall: check exists وبعدين insert من غير unique constraint عرضة للـrace. متعتمدش على redirect صفحة النجاح لتأكيد الدفع.

questions.title: Last item in stock
questions.question: Two requests buy the last item at the same time. Show how you prevent overselling in Laravel.
questions.lesson: Transaction لوحدها مش بتمنع كل races. تقدر تستخدم row lock جوه transaction أو conditional atomic decrement وتفحص affected rows. خلي الـtransaction قصيرة.
questions.model: Use DB::transaction and lockForUpdate, read stock, reject insufficient quantity, then decrement and create the reservation. Alternatively use an atomic conditional UPDATE where stock >= quantity and check affected rows. Keep external payment calls outside the lock, retry deadlocks safely and test concurrent requests.
questions.pitfall: الـlock لازم يتاخد قبل قراءة stock ويستمر لحد commit. SQLite مش بديل كامل لاختبار MySQL locking.
bad: transaction alone prevents all race conditions

questions.title: Payment timeouts
questions.question: A charge request times out after the provider may have processed it. Is retrying safe?
questions.lesson: Timeout مش دليل إن العملية فشلت؛ ممكن الطرف التاني نفذها والـresponse ضاع. استخدم idempotency key ثابت للمحاولة المنطقية وتابع status.
questions.model: Treat the result as unknown. Retry with the same provider idempotency key for the logical payment, within the provider guarantee, and persist that key. Reconcile via provider status and verified webhooks. Use bounded backoff for transient failures and never create a new charge blindly.
questions.pitfall: إنشاء key جديدة عند كل retry ممكن يخصم من العميل مرتين.

questions.title: Refund workflow
questions.question: Design partial refunds with two concurrent refund requests against the same payment.
questions.lesson: Refund محتاج cumulative total مضبوط، authorization، وحالة pending لما provider outcome مش معروف. حساب المتبقي وكتابة reservation لازم atomic.
questions.model: Authorize the operation and compute refundable balance from trusted ledger data. Atomically reserve the amount, persist a unique refund key and call the provider idempotently. Model pending/succeeded/failed states, reconcile ambiguous results and prevent total refunds exceeding the captured amount under concurrency.
questions.pitfall: متطرحش من balance ثم ترجعها عشوائيًا بعد timeout؛ العملية الخارجية ممكن تكون نجحت.

questions.title: Out-of-order events
questions.question: A payment.failed webhook arrives after payment.succeeded. How do you keep state consistent?
questions.lesson: وصول events بالترتيب مش مضمون. لازم transition rules أو provider versioning وreconciliation بدل overwrite حسب وقت الاستقبال.
questions.model: Verify and deduplicate events, apply allowed monotonic state transitions or provider sequence/version rules, and consult the provider when state is ambiguous. Keep an event audit trail, update atomically and test out-of-order delivery; a late failure must not blindly overwrite a confirmed capture.
questions.pitfall: Timestamp المحلي بتاع وصول الـevent مش ترتيب حصول الأحداث عند provider.

questions.title: Reservation expiry
questions.question: Inventory is reserved for 15 minutes, but a payment succeeds after the reservation expires. What happens?
questions.lesson: لازم سياسة واضحة للتعويض: تعيد حجز المخزون لو متاح، أو refund، أو manual review. Expiry job والـwebhook لازم يتنافسوا على نفس state بشكل atomic.
questions.model: Use explicit reservation and payment states with conditional atomic transitions. On late success, re-reserve stock if policy allows and availability is confirmed; otherwise refund or escalate. Make expiry and success handlers idempotent, record every decision and test their concurrent execution.
questions.pitfall: Expiry مش cancellation تلقائية للـpayment عند provider؛ الاتنين أنظمة منفصلة.

questions.title: Idempotency key scope
questions.question: Can a client reuse one idempotency key for a different order or amount? Design server behavior.
questions.lesson: Idempotency record محتاج scope للـuser/tenant والـoperation، request fingerprint، وحالة processing/result. نفس المفتاح مع body مختلف لازم يترفض.
questions.model: Scope keys by actor and operation, persist a request fingerprint and unique constraint, and reject reuse with a different payload. Handle simultaneous first requests atomically, replay a completed result and expose a safe pending state. Define retention and provider-key mapping; do not store sensitive payloads unnecessarily.
questions.pitfall: وجود key header من غير تخزين atomic ومقارنة payload مش implementation كامل للـidempotency.

questions.title: Ledger consistency
questions.question: Why keep immutable payment ledger entries instead of only updating an orders.paid boolean?
questions.lesson: Ledger بيحتفظ بأثر الحركات والتصحيحات، فيسهّل reconciliation وaudit. الرصيد النهائي مشتق من entries متوازنة حسب النموذج، ومش مجرد flag.
questions.model: Record immutable charge/refund adjustments linked to provider references and business operations. Enforce uniqueness and atomic posting, derive or reconcile balances and preserve an audit trail. Correct errors with compensating entries instead of rewriting history; use an appropriate accounting model and tests for totals.
questions.pitfall: Logging نصي للـHTTP calls مش بديل عن financial records منظمة.

questions.title: Strategy
questions.question: Shipping calculation has a growing switch for each carrier. How could Strategy help, and when would it be overkill?
questions.lesson: Strategy بيفصل algorithms قابلة للتبديل وراء contract. مناسب لما كل carrier ليه logic متغير، لكن شرطين بسيطين مش لازم يتحولوا لعشر classes.
questions.model: Define a ShippingStrategy contract with quote(), implement carrier-specific strategies and choose one through a resolver. Inject dependencies and unit-test each algorithm. Keep a simple conditional when behavior is small and stable; avoid creating abstractions without meaningful variation.
questions.pitfall: Strategy بيغيّر الـalgorithm؛ Factory بيركّز على إنشاء/اختيار object.

questions.title: Adapter
questions.question: Your app uses two SMS providers with different payloads. How do you keep application code vendor independent?
questions.lesson: Adapter بيترجم interface خارجي لـcontract محلي. خليه مسؤول عن mapping وvendor errors؛ business rules تفضل في التطبيق.
questions.model: Define an SmsSender contract owned by the application. Each adapter translates our message to the vendor payload and maps responses and errors to domain results. Inject the chosen adapter, protect secrets and timeouts, and contract-test both implementations with fake HTTP responses.
questions.pitfall: متسرّبش vendor-specific response لكل الـservices وإلا التبديل هيفضل مكلف.

questions.title: Observer and events
questions.question: An order observer sends an email before the database transaction commits. What can go wrong and how would you fix it?
questions.lesson: Side effects قبل commit ممكن تعلن عن order اتعمله rollback. Events تقلل coupling، لكن لازم تفكر في delivery guarantees وتكرار jobs.
questions.model: The email may refer to rolled-back data or a worker may run before records are committed. Dispatch the listener or job after commit, make the handler idempotent, and use a transactional outbox when durable delivery is required. Keep critical invariants inside the transaction.
questions.pitfall: afterCommit بيعالج توقيت الـdispatch، لكنه لوحده مش ضمان durable delivery وقت crash بين commit وenqueue.

questions.title: Repository trade-offs
questions.question: Should every Eloquent model have a repository that simply wraps find and save? Defend your choice.
questions.lesson: Repository abstraction مفيد لما له contract domain واضح أو queries معقدة أو storage boundary. Wrapper بيكرر Eloquent من غير معنى ممكن يزود indirection بس.
questions.model: Do not add a repository mechanically. Use Eloquent directly for simple application queries, or introduce a domain-focused repository/query service when it encapsulates meaningful persistence policy. Keep contracts specific, test behavior and consider transaction boundaries instead of promising an effortless database replacement.
questions.pitfall: تبديل MySQL لـMongoDB مش بيبقى سهل لمجرد وجود IRepository عام.

questions.title: Decorator
questions.question: Add metrics and caching around a pricing service without changing its public contract. Which pattern fits?
questions.lesson: Decorator بيلف service بنفس contract ويضيف behavior قبل وبعد delegation. ترتيب wrappers مهم، خصوصًا caching وmetrics والأخطاء.
questions.model: Implement decorators that satisfy the pricing contract and delegate to the wrapped service. Compose caching and metrics explicitly, define key/invalidation policy and whether metrics include cache hits. Preserve error semantics, avoid caching unsafe personalized results and test wrapper ordering.
questions.pitfall: Decorator مش inheritance شرطًا؛ وقيمة cache key الغلط ممكن تسرّب سعر tenant لتاني.

questions.title: Factory and construction
questions.question: A request contains a provider name. How do you build a gateway safely without dynamic arbitrary class names?
questions.lesson: Factory بيحدد طريقة إنشاء object من اختيار مسموح. لازم allowlist بدل تحويل user input مباشرة لاسم class.
questions.model: Map supported provider identifiers to registered gateway factories or container bindings. Reject unknown providers, inject dependencies and keep credentials server-side. Return the application contract, test each mapping and avoid arbitrary class instantiation from request input.
questions.pitfall: new $request->class بيحوّل input المستخدم لاختيار executable code.

questions.title: Command and use cases
questions.question: An action can be triggered from HTTP, CLI and a job. How do you avoid duplicating business rules?
questions.lesson: Use case أو Command handler بيجمع workflow التطبيق ويستقبل input واضح. Delivery mechanisms زي Controller وCommand console مجرد adapters.
questions.model: Create an application action with validated input and explicit dependencies, called by thin HTTP, CLI and job adapters. Keep authorization context explicit, place business invariants in domain logic and define transaction/idempotency boundaries. Test the action once and integration-test each adapter.
questions.pitfall: نقل Request object نفسه للـdomain بيخلّيه مربوط بالـHTTP.

questions.title: Domain events versus jobs
questions.question: When should OrderPlaced be an event and GenerateInvoice be a job? How do you handle delivery failure?
questions.lesson: Event بيحكي حقيقة حصلت؛ Command/Job بيطلب شغل يحصل. فصل المعنيين بيساعد على ownership، لكن queues مش ضمان exactly-once.
questions.model: Publish OrderPlaced to announce a committed fact and use GenerateInvoice as work assigned to a handler. Keep critical invariants synchronous, use after-commit/outbox where required, and design retries, idempotency and failed-job monitoring. Avoid relying on an optional event listener for an essential unchecked invariant.
questions.pitfall: Event اسمه SendEmail مش وصف لحقيقة؛ ده أقرب لـcommand.

questions.title: Scale horizontally
questions.question: Traffic grows 10x and you add three Laravel servers. What state and infrastructure need attention?
questions.lesson: Horizontal scaling محتاج instances تقدر تتبدل من غير فقد session أو uploads. الـload balancer يوزع traffic، والـDB يفضل bottleneck محتمل لازم يتقاس.
questions.model: Use a load balancer and stateless app instances, shared Redis sessions/cache and object storage for uploads. Run independent queue workers, coordinate scheduler execution, share secrets safely and monitor database capacity, p95 latency, errors and queue lag before adding replicas or other complexity.
questions.pitfall: إضافة app servers لوحدها مش بتحل DB saturation، والـlocal files مش هتظهر لباقي الـinstances.

questions.title: Reliable queues
questions.question: A queued invoice job can run more than once or fail halfway. How do you make it reliable?
questions.lesson: افترض at-least-once processing. الـjob لازم يبقى idempotent، ليه timeout وretry policy، والفشل يتشاف ويتراجع. متعتبرش dispatch ضمان تنفيذ.
questions.model: Make the job idempotent with a persisted unique business key and atomic state changes. Configure bounded retries, backoff and timeouts with retry_after longer than processing timeout. Track failed jobs and queue lag, alert operators, and use after-commit dispatch or an outbox as needed.
questions.pitfall: tries كتير من غير idempotency ممكن تضاعف الأثر بدل ما تصلّح الفشل.

questions.title: Read replicas
questions.question: You send reads to a replica. Right after checkout, the order is missing. Why, and what can you do?
questions.lesson: Read replicas ممكن تتأخر عن primary بسبب replication lag. اختار consistency requirements لكل flow، خصوصًا read-after-write زي عرض order جديد.
questions.model: Replication lag causes stale reads. Route consistency-sensitive reads to the primary; Laravel sticky reads can help within the same request after a write, but do not guarantee consistency across subsequent requests. Monitor lag and design an explicit read-after-write policy; replicas do not scale writes.
questions.pitfall: Replica مش backup بديل، ومش حل تلقائي للـwrite scaling.

questions.title: Database partitioning
questions.question: When would you consider partitioning, sharding or read replicas? Compare what each solves.
questions.lesson: Partitioning غالبًا تقسيم منطقي/فعلي داخل DB حسب engine، sharding بيوزع data على DBs مستقلة، replicas نسخ قراءة. اختار بعد قياس bottleneck.
questions.model: Replicas can offload suitable reads with lag trade-offs; partitioning can aid pruning and retention for aligned queries; sharding distributes data and write load across independent databases. Measure first and account for routing, cross-shard joins/transactions, hot keys and operational cost before adding complexity.
questions.pitfall: Partition by year مش حل لكل query، ولو filters مبتستخدمش partition key ممكن مفيش pruning مفيد.

questions.title: Backpressure
questions.question: An import produces jobs faster than workers process them. How do you prevent an outage?
questions.lesson: Backpressure بيخلي المنتج يحترم قدرة المستهلك بدل تراكم شغل بلا حدود. تابع queue age، limits، وDB capacity، مش worker count بس.
questions.model: Bound producer rate and batch sizes, monitor oldest job age and queue depth, and scale workers within downstream capacity. Isolate critical queues, apply quotas or admission control and make retries bounded with jitter. Avoid adding workers until the database and provider rate limits are understood.
questions.pitfall: Unbounded retries ممكن تعمل retry storm وتزود نفس العطل.

questions.title: Consistency and CAP
questions.question: During a network partition, can a distributed system guarantee both availability and linearizable consistency? Explain without slogans.
questions.lesson: CAP بيتكلم عن network partitions وtradeoff محدد بين consistency بمعنى linearizability وavailability بمعناها النظري. مش قاعدة “اختار اتنين” لكل قرار تصميم.
questions.model: Under a network partition, a distributed service cannot guarantee both linearizable consistency and availability for every request. Decide per operation: payments may reject or defer uncertain writes, while a catalog may tolerate stale reads. State the partition model, user-visible behavior and recovery/reconciliation plan.
questions.pitfall: Eventual consistency محتاجة converging rules ومش وعد إن أي تعارض هيتحل لوحده.

questions.title: File upload architecture
questions.question: Large uploads tie up app workers. Design a scalable secure upload flow.
questions.lesson: Direct-to-object-storage uploads ممكن تقلل ضغط السيرفر، لكن signed URL مش تصريح شامل لأي file. finalize step لازم يتحقق من ownership والـobject metadata.
questions.model: Authorize an upload intent, issue a short-lived scoped signed URL and upload directly to object storage. Validate final object size/type and ownership, scan or quarantine where required and store metadata separately. Limit quotas, protect private downloads and clean up abandoned uploads.
questions.pitfall: Content-Type header من العميل مش إثبات نوع الملف الحقيقي.

questions.title: Service boundaries
questions.question: Should a small Laravel team split a working monolith into microservices to prepare for scale?
questions.lesson: Microservices بتضيف network failures وdistributed data ownership وdeployment complexity. Modular monolith ممكن يكون خطوة أنسب قبل التقسيم حسب احتياج حقيقي.
questions.model: Start with a modular monolith and explicit domain boundaries unless independent scaling, ownership or deployment needs justify extraction. Measure bottlenecks, define data ownership and contracts, and budget for observability, retries and distributed consistency. Extract one bounded capability with a reversible migration rather than splitting every model.
questions.pitfall: عدد services مش مقياس جودة architecture.

questions.title: Prompt with constraints
questions.question: You ask an AI assistant to implement a Laravel webhook. What context and acceptance criteria should you provide?
questions.lesson: Prompt كويس يوضح behavior والـconstraints والـfailure modes. ادّي schema وعينات sanitized، وحدد tests ومعايير القبول بدل “اعمل webhook”.
questions.model: Provide framework version, relevant routes/schema and sanitized provider examples. Specify signature verification, unique event IDs, atomic state transitions, idempotent side effects and HTTP responses. Ask for concurrency and duplicate-event tests, document assumptions, and exclude credentials and customer data.
questions.pitfall: متبعتش production secrets أو بيانات عملاء حقيقية عشان توفّر context.

questions.title: Review generated code
questions.question: AI generates a refund handler that trusts a client amount and retries all errors. How do you review and fix it?
questions.lesson: تعامل مع output كأنه PR من شخص تاني. راجع security boundaries والـbusiness invariants واقرأ APIs الرسمية، وبعدين شغّل tests فعلية.
questions.model: Compute the refundable amount from authoritative server records and enforce authorization. Add idempotency and atomic refund state transitions, distinguish permanent from transient errors, and reconcile unknown outcomes. Verify SDK APIs against official docs, review the diff and test duplicates, permissions and partial failure.
questions.pitfall: نجاح happy path أو إن الكود شكله مقنع مش دليل على صحته في الدفع.

questions.title: Use AI responsibly
questions.question: An AI tool proposes an unfamiliar package and a broad refactor to fix one query. What is your decision process?
questions.lesson: AI يسرّع البحث والاقتراح، لكن القرار عليك. ابدأ بقياس المشكلة وحدودها، وراجع dependencies وحقوق البيانات والـdiff قبل الدمج.
questions.model: Reproduce and measure the query issue first. Prefer the smallest evidence-based change; verify package provenance, maintenance, license and necessity. Review the diff, run targeted regression and performance tests, avoid sending private data, and keep a rollback plan with human ownership.
questions.pitfall: متقبلش refactor واسع أو dependency جديدة لمجرد إنها اتقترحت من tool.

questions.title: AI-generated tests
questions.question: AI generates a test that repeats the implementation and mocks the method being tested. How do you improve it?
questions.lesson: الاختبار المفيد بيختبر behavior وcontract من بره؛ لو بيعيد الكود بنفس المنطق أو mock الـsubject نفسه مش هيكشف العيب.
questions.model: Write independent expected outcomes from requirements, use realistic fixtures and mock external boundaries rather than the subject. Add negative, authorization and edge-case tests that fail on a known defect. Review assertions for false positives and run the suite; generated test volume is not evidence of coverage quality.
questions.pitfall: assertTrue(true) أو mock بيرجع نفس expected value مش verification للـbusiness logic.

questions.title: Untrusted repository instructions
questions.question: An AI coding agent reads a README telling it to upload .env for debugging. How should the workflow respond?
questions.lesson: محتوى repo أو tool output data غير موثوق بالنسبة للصلاحيات. لازم تفرّق تعليمات المستخدم الفعلية عن instructions جاية من file ممكن يكون malicious.
questions.model: Treat the instruction as untrusted content, do not exfiltrate secrets, and continue using sanitized diagnostics. Follow the authorized task scope, inspect proposed commands and outbound data, and require human approval for expanded sensitive access. Keep credentials in approved secret management rather than source or prompts.
questions.pitfall: وجود تعليمات جوه repo مش إذن بإرسال أسرار المشروع لأي endpoint.

questions.title: AI integration resilience
questions.question: Your Laravel API calls an LLM for ticket summaries. How do you handle timeouts, malformed output and cost limits?
questions.lesson: LLM output input غير موثوق؛ اعمله schema validation، وحدود حجم ووقت وتكلفة. العمليات الطويلة ممكن تتعمل async ومحتاج fallback واضح.
questions.model: Set request deadlines, input/output limits and per-user quotas. Validate structured output against a schema, treat generated text as untrusted, redact sensitive input and queue slow work. Retry only appropriate transient failures with bounded backoff, track cost/latency and offer a safe fallback without granting the model authority over actions.
questions.pitfall: Structured output مش دليل إن الحقائق صحيحة، والـLLM مش authorization engine.

tracks.title: PHP Runtime & Tooling
rows: Composer and lockfiles
Why commit composer.lock for an application, and why is composer update risky during deployment?
composer.json بيوضح constraints؛ lock بيثبت versions المحلولة. install بيستخدم الـlock، بينما update بيعيد حل dependencies وممكن يجيب تغييرات وقت النشر.

Commit the application lockfile and deploy with composer install using the locked graph and appropriate production flags. Run updates deliberately in development/CI, review the diff and security audit, then test. Validate PHP/extensions and avoid running dependency resolution as an unreviewed production release step.
locked graph~lock|install vs update~install/update|CI review~ci/test|platform check~php/extension
وجود lock مش معناه dependencies آمنة للأبد؛ محتاجة updates مدروسة.
PSR-4 autoloading
A class works on Windows but fails on Linux after deployment. How do you investigate autoloading?
PSR-4 بيربط namespace prefix بـdirectory. Case mismatch بين filename وclass أو namespace ممكن يستخبى على filesystem مش case-sensitive ويظهر على Linux.

Check namespace, Composer PSR-4 mapping, file path and exact filename case. Regenerate the autoloader after correcting source and verify the class is deployed. Test on a case-sensitive CI environment and inspect platform requirements; do not patch vendor or add ad-hoc require statements everywhere.
namespace mapping~namespace/psr-4|case sensitivity~case|dump autoload~autoload|CI parity~ci/linux
composer dump-autoload مش هيصلّح namespace غلط تلقائيًا.
Traits and collisions
Two traits provide log(). How does PHP resolve the collision, and when is a composed logger preferable?
Trait وسيلة reuse أفقي للـmethods. Collision لازم يتحدد صراحة بـinsteadof وas، لكن traits كتير بتعتمد على hidden state ممكن تعمل coupling صعب.

Resolve conflicting methods with insteadof and optionally alias with as. Review required state and hooks. Prefer injecting a LoggerInterface when logging is a replaceable dependency; traits do not establish a consumer-facing type contract and should not hide complex dependencies.
insteadof~insteadof|alias~as/alias|dependency injection~inject/loggerinterface|trait limits~contract/state
as بيعمل alias أو visibility adjustment؛ مش بديل لوحده لحل conflict الأصلي.
Late static binding
In a base class factory, how do self:: and static:: differ when called through a subclass?
self بيتحل حسب class اللي الكود مكتوب فيه؛ static بيستخدم late static binding للـcalled class. خلي inheritance behavior واضح ومتعملش factory assumption يخالف constructor requirements.

self refers to the defining class context, while static uses the runtime called class for late static binding. A factory using new static can create a subclass, so ensure compatible construction and return contracts. Test inherited calls and prefer explicit factories if subclass invariants differ.
self lexical~self/defining|static runtime~static/called|construction contract~construct/contract|subclass tests~test/subclass
new static مش آمن تلقائيًا لو subclass constructor محتاج inputs مختلفة.
OPcache and processes
How do PHP-FPM, OPcache and a long-running queue worker affect code deployment and state?
FPM بيدير processes للـrequests؛ OPcache بيخزن compiled bytecode. Queue worker طويل العمر محتاج restart عشان يحمّل الكود الجديد؛ كل lifetime له تبعات state مختلفة.

OPcache avoids recompilation but does not cache query results. Configure release-aware cache invalidation/reload for PHP-FPM, restart queue workers gracefully and use the documented reload procedure for long-lived HTTP workers. Keep shared business state outside process memory and verify a release identifier after deployment.
bytecode~bytecode/opcache|worker restart~restart/worker|shared state~state|release verification~release/verify
إعادة تشغيل web server بس ممكن تسيب queue workers شغالة بكود قديم.
Static analysis
What can PHPStan or Psalm catch that unit tests may miss, and what can they not prove?
Static analysis بيمسك type mismatches وunreachable assumptions من غير تنفيذ كل paths. Tests بتختبر behavior فعلي؛ الاتنين بيكملوا بعض، ومش ضمان لغياب bugs.

Run static analysis in CI with accurate types and a managed baseline, progressively reducing suppressions. It can catch inconsistent returns, nullability and invalid calls across unexecuted paths. Keep behavioral, integration and concurrency tests because analysis cannot prove business correctness or external system behavior.
types nullability~type/null|CI baseline~ci/baseline|behavior tests~test|limitations~business/external
تمرير analysis مع annotations غلط ممكن يدي إحساس زائف بالأمان.
