questions.lesson: Static analysis بيمسك type mismatches وunreachable assumptions من غير تنفيذ كل paths. Tests بتختبر behavior فعلي؛ الاتنين بيكملوا بعض، ومش ضمان لغياب bugs.
questions.model: Run static analysis in CI with accurate types and a managed baseline, progressively reducing suppressions. It can catch inconsistent returns, nullability and invalid calls across unexecuted paths. Keep behavioral, integration and concurrency tests because analysis cannot prove business correctness or external system behavior.
questions.pitfall: تمرير analysis مع annotations غلط ممكن يدي إحساس زائف بالأمان.

tracks.title: Laravel Routing & Validation
rows: Route model binding
A nested route /projects/{project}/tasks/{task} returns a task from another project. How do you fix it?
Implicit binding بيربط model بالـroute، لكنه مش تصريح تلقائي للعلاقة أو للـownership. Scoped binding والـpolicy بيحلوا جزئين مختلفين.

Use scoped nested binding or explicitly resolve the task through the project relation, then authorize the action with a policy. Test mismatched parent/child IDs and tenant boundaries, return the appropriate not-found or forbidden response and do not trust hidden form fields for ownership.
scoped binding~scope|relation resolution~relation/project|policy~policy/authoriz|negative tests~test/mismatch
إن task ID موجود في DB مش معناه إنه تابع للـproject المطلوب.
FormRequest rules and authorization
Where do you put input rules, ownership checks and business invariants in a create-order flow?
FormRequest للـvalidation والـrequest authorization. الـdomain invariants لازم تفضل محمية حتى لو الـoperation اتندهت من CLI أو job.

Use FormRequest rules for input shape and authorize/policies for caller permissions. Build a validated DTO or explicit payload. Enforce inventory/pricing invariants inside the application/domain action with transactional protection, and test both HTTP failures and direct action calls.
FormRequest~formrequest|authorization~authoriz/policy|explicit payload~dto/validated|domain invariant~invariant/transaction
Validation success مش ضمان لاستمرار stock متاح لحد لحظة الكتابة.
Unique validation on update
How do you ignore the current user when validating email uniqueness without trusting a request-provided ignore ID?
Rule::unique()->ignore لازم يستخدم trusted model ID، مش input ممكن يتلاعب بيه المستخدم. الـDB unique constraint لسه ضروري ضد concurrent writes.

Authorize the update and pass the trusted bound user/model to Rule::unique(...)->ignore(...). Scope uniqueness if the domain requires it and retain a matching database unique constraint. Handle constraint conflicts and test an attacker-supplied ID plus simultaneous updates.
trusted ignore~trusted/model|unique rule~unique|database constraint~constraint|tests~test/concurrent
validation query والـinsert بينهم وقت؛ uniqueness invariant لازم يتفرض في DB.
Nested validation
An order payload has line items with product_id, quantity and extra admin fields. How do you validate and map it safely?
Wildcards بتتحقق من items.*، لكن لازم تضبط allowed keys وتبني payload صريح. متستخدمش request->all للـmass assignment.

Validate array shape, size and allowed keys; validate each product ID and positive quantity, and handle duplicates according to policy. Use validated data with an explicit field mapping, compute prices server-side and reject or ignore unknown fields consistently. Test nested authorization and oversized arrays.
wildcard shape~items/array|explicit keys~allowlist/validated|server price~server/price|bounds tests~test/size
exists:products,id لوحده مش بيأكد إن المنتج متاح للـtenant أو للبيع.
Route order and caching
Why might /reports/export resolve as /reports/{report}? How do route constraints and deployment checks help?
Dynamic route ممكن يطابق كلمة export لو مفيش constraint أو ترتيب مناسب. راجع route:list واختبر routes بعد تفعيل cache في release pipeline.

Define specific routes appropriately and constrain dynamic parameters, for example numeric IDs or supported UUIDs. Inspect route:list and named routes, test export versus show resolution and run route-cache checks during deployment. Use stable names rather than duplicating URLs throughout the app.
constraints~constraint/where|specific routes~specific/order|route list~route:list|deployment tests~test/cache
Route caching تحسين bootstrap، مش أداة تصلّح route design غلط.
Request normalization
A checkbox is absent when false and a numeric string reaches your action. How do you normalize input without hiding invalid data?
Normalize اللي الـcontract يسمح بيه قبل mapping، وخلّي validation يرفض malformed input بدل cast أعمى زي (int)"abc" اللي يتحول صفر.

Define omission/default semantics, validate accepted boolean and numeric representations and normalize deliberately through FormRequest preparation or a DTO mapper. Preserve null versus missing when required and use validated values, not raw request data. Test absent, malformed and boundary values.
defined defaults~default/omission|validation before cast~validat|normalization~normaliz/prepareforvalidation|edge tests~test/malformed
casting مش validation؛ ممكن يخلي قيمة غلط تبان valid.

tracks.title: Laravel Eloquent & Collections
rows: Relationship design
Model users, roles and role assignment metadata. When do you use belongsToMany and a pivot model?
Many-to-many محتاج join table. Pivot metadata زي assigned_by وexpires_at ليها validation وconstraints؛ أحيانًا assignment نفسه يستاهل entity مستقلة.

Use belongsToMany with a pivot table and relevant foreign/unique constraints. Expose needed pivot attributes explicitly and use a custom pivot model for appropriate casting/behavior, or a first-class assignment entity when lifecycle complexity grows. Test attach/sync/detach semantics and permissions.
many-to-many~belongstomany/pivot|constraints~unique/foreign|metadata model~cast/entity|sync tests~sync/test
sync من غير وعي ممكن يفصل roles موجودة مش مبعوتة في الطلب.
Query scopes and tenancy
A global tenant scope protects HTTP queries. What can go wrong in jobs, admin tools or raw queries?
Global scope مفيد بس مش security boundary وحيد. jobs محتاجة tenant context صريح وraw queries ممكن متستخدمش Eloquent scopes أصلًا.

Pass tenant context explicitly into jobs and actions, audit scope bypasses and raw SQL, and apply authorization independently. Use local scopes for reusable filters and global scopes carefully. Test cross-tenant paths including background jobs and admin exceptions; avoid silently defaulting to an arbitrary tenant.
explicit tenant~tenant/context|bypass audit~raw/withoutglobalscope|authorization~authoriz|cross-path tests~test/job
Global scope مش شغال تلقائيًا على DB::table أو كل database access.
Mass assignment
Why does fillable not replace authorization or field validation? Give an is_admin escalation example.
fillable بيحدّد fields اللي mass assignment يقبلها؛ مش مين يحق له يعدّلها ولا إذا كانت القيمة valid. الحماية محتاجة layers متكاملة.

Allowlist assignable fields, validate input and authorize sensitive changes separately. Map ordinary profile fields explicitly and keep is_admin or tenant_id out of untrusted profile payloads. Test field injection and privileged endpoints; direct property assignment still requires review even with guarded models.
fillable role~fillable/allowlist|validation~validat|authorization~authoriz/policy|injection tests~test/is_admin
$guarded مش بيحمي من كل direct assignment ولا بيصلّح controller بيقبل fields خطرة عمدًا.
Casts and accessors
An encrypted cast is added to a column used for search and indexing. What changes?
Casts بتعمل transformations بين storage والـmodel. Encryption المعتادة مش searchable بشكل مباشر، وممكن تزود حجم التخزين وتؤثر على migration والـkey rotation.

Assess query needs before encrypting. Use supported encrypted casts with suitable column capacity, protect keys and plan rotation/migration. Do not expect normal equality/range indexes on ciphertext to preserve plaintext query semantics; separate carefully designed searchable metadata only with an explicit threat model.
query limitation~search/index|key management~key/rotation|storage migration~column/migrat|threat model~threat/metadata
Hashing وencryption مش interchangeable، وblind index ليه leakage tradeoffs محتاجة تصميم.
Bulk updates and events
A bulk Eloquent update changes 10,000 rows, but observers do not run for each model. Why?
Mass update بيتنفذ query واحدة من غير hydrate لكل model؛ per-model events مش هتتنادى بنفس الشكل. لو side effect أساسي لازم تختار workflow يناسبه.

Bulk updates do not retrieve individual models, so per-model update events are not dispatched as with saving each instance. Choose explicit batch side-effect handling or controlled per-model processing, make work idempotent and test expected events. Balance correctness with query volume and transaction size.
no hydration~hydrate/retrieve|events behavior~event/observer|explicit processing~batch/explicit|idempotent tests~test/idempot
متبنيش critical invariant على observer لو في write paths بتتخطاه.
Collections versus builders
What is the difference between User::where(...)->get()->filter(...) and filtering in SQL?
Query Builder بيبني SQL لحد التنفيذ. Collection بتشتغل على data اتحمّلت خلاص؛ filter في الذاكرة ممكن يستهلك RAM وينقل rows ملهاش لازمة.

Push supported filtering, sorting and aggregates into SQL before get and select only required columns. Collections operate in application memory; use them for small loaded sets or domain transformations. Use lazy iteration where suitable, inspect query execution points and measure database versus application cost.
execution point~get/sql|memory collection~memory/collection|push filtering~where/database|measurement~measure/lazy
Collection count بعد get مش نفس كفاءة SELECT COUNT للـdataset الكبيرة.

questions.title: Relationship cardinality
questions.question: Model Customer→Orders→Items plus an optional Profile. Explain where foreign keys live and when hasManyThrough helps.
questions.lesson: belongsTo غالبًا على الطرف اللي عنده foreign key؛ hasMany على الأب؛ hasOne يصف association واحدة لكن uniqueness لازم DB تفرضها. Through relationship بتبسّط traversal مناسبة.
questions.model: Put customer_id on orders and order_id on items, use belongsTo/hasMany for the two directions, and enforce a unique customer_id on a one-to-one profile if required. Use a supported through relation for indirect access and test cardinality, deletion behavior and eager-loading query growth.
questions.pitfall: hasOne في model مش unique constraint يمنع وجود profile تانية للعميل.

questions.title: Polymorphic relations
questions.question: Comments can belong to posts or videos. Compare polymorphic relations with separate tables or a shared parent entity.
questions.lesson: Polymorphic relation بتخزن type وID وبتدي flexibility، لكن FK للـtarget أصعب من relationship عادية. Morph map بيثبّت public storage aliases بدل class names.
questions.model: Use morphTo and corresponding morph relations when the shared behavior justifies it, define a stable morph map and authorize each target type. Account for weaker direct foreign-key enforcement, indexes and eager loading per type. Compare separate associations or a shared parent model and test target deletion and invalid types.
questions.pitfall: متقبلش arbitrary class name من request كـmorph type من غير allowlist.

tracks.title: Laravel Auth & Authorization
rows: Guards and providers
Explain the difference between an auth guard and a user provider when building an admin portal.
Guard بيحدد آلية authentication وحالتها؛ provider بيحدد إزاي تجيب user من storage. فصلهم مهم لما يبقى في أكتر من نوع client أو user source.

A guard defines how authentication is maintained for a request, while a user provider retrieves users and validates credentials against storage. Choose guards for the required session/token flow, configure middleware explicitly and enforce admin authorization through policies/permissions rather than guard names alone.
guard mechanism~guard/session|provider storage~provider/storage|middleware~middleware|admin permission~permission/policy
اسم guard=admin مش proof إن أي user authenticated عليه يملك كل صلاحيات الإدارة.
Login and session fixation
What should happen to session state after a successful login and after logout?
Session fixation بيتقلل بتجديد session ID بعد login. Logout لازم ينهي session وحماية CSRF تتجدد، ومع tokens فيه revocation policy مختلفة.

Regenerate the session ID after authentication. On logout, log out the guard, invalidate the session and regenerate the CSRF token using framework helpers. Use secure cookie settings, define remember-me and token revocation policy and test that an old session cannot perform protected actions.
regenerate login~regenerat|invalidate logout~invalidat|CSRF renewal~csrf|security tests~test/cookie
حذف user_id بس من session مش lifecycle كامل لتسجيل الخروج.
Policies and gates
When do you choose a Policy rather than a Gate, and how do you prevent IDOR?
Policy بتنظم authorization المرتبطة بـmodel؛ Gate مناسب لقدرة عامة. لازم checks على object المطلوب نفسه، مش مجرد وجود role.

Use policies for resource actions and gates for broader abilities. Resolve the resource in the correct tenant scope, check the authenticated actor against that resource and deny by default. Test cross-user IDs, alternate verbs and bulk endpoints; authentication and opaque IDs do not prevent IDOR.
resource policy~policy|general gate~gate|resource ownership~tenant/owner|IDOR tests~test/idor
UUID يصعّب التخمين لكنه مش authorization.
Roles versus permissions
A role name is hard-coded in twenty controllers. How would you redesign access control?
Role بيجمع permissions، لكن application logic الأفضل تسأل عن ability محددة. Data ownership ولسه محتاجة policies حتى لو user عنده role قوي.

Define explicit abilities and map roles to permissions centrally. Enforce permissions and resource ownership through policies, scope by tenant where needed and invalidate permission caches after changes. Test least privilege, revoked access and admin exceptions; avoid duplicating role strings throughout controllers.
abilities~abilit/permission|central mapping~central/role|resource policy~policy/owner|revocation tests~test/revok
RBAC مش بديل عن object-level constraints أو separation of duties.
Password reset tokens
How do you secure a password reset flow against account enumeration and token abuse?
Reset flow محتاج random single-use expiring tokens، response ما يكشفش existence، وrate limits. استخدم framework broker بدل اختراع crypto.

Use Laravel’s password broker, short-lived single-use tokens and generic responses. Rate-limit requests and submissions, protect reset URLs and logs, invalidate tokens after success and define session revocation policy. Test expiry, replay and cross-account token reuse without logging reset secrets.
broker token~broker/token|generic response~generic/enumerat|expiry replay~expir/replay|rate limit~rate/limit
متبعتش reset tokens للـanalytics أو logs أو third-party URLs.
Token abilities and revocation
A token has orders:read but the user loses tenant membership. Should the endpoint still allow access?
Token ability scope مش snapshot نهائي للـauthorization. لازم العضوية وحالة الحساب والـresource policy يتراجعوا وقت الطلب حسب المتطلبات.

No. Check token ability plus current account and tenant membership and resource policy. Revoke tokens on relevant security events, use appropriate expiry and record audited token lifecycle events. Test lost membership, suspended users and deleted resources; a bearer token must not bypass current authorization.
ability plus policy~policy/abilit|current membership~membership/current|revocation~revok/expiry|negative tests~test/suspend
Long-lived token محتاج lifecycle واضح؛ authorization مش ثابت للأبد وقت إصدار token.

tracks.title: Laravel Queues & Events
rows: Job payload design
Why avoid serializing request objects or secrets into a job? What do queued Eloquent models imply?
Queue payload بيتخزن وممكن يظهر في failed jobs؛ ابعت minimal IDs وcontext. Serialized model غالبًا بيتعاد جلبه وقت التنفيذ، فالحالة ممكن تكون اتغيرت.

Pass minimal identifiers and explicit tenant context, never raw requests or secrets. Understand model rehydration and re-check required state and authorization at execution time. Handle deleted models, avoid unintended loaded relationships and use explicit immutable snapshots only when the business operation requires historical values.
minimal payload~minimal/id|rehydration~rehydrat/re-fetch|tenant and state~tenant/state|sensitive data~secret
Passing model للـjob مش ضمان إن attributes هتفضل نفس قيم لحظة dispatch.
Chains and batches
Compare a job chain with a batch for an import workflow. What happens on failure?
Chain لشغل مرتب يعتمد على اللي قبله؛ Batch لتجميع شغل له progress/cancel/failure handling. لا دي ولا دي transaction واحدة عبر كل jobs.

Use a chain for sequential dependencies and a batch for grouped work with progress and cancellation behavior. Configure failure handling explicitly, ensure each job is idempotent and respect cancellation. Persist checkpoints and test partial failure; neither mechanism provides one atomic database transaction across all jobs.
chain ordering~chain/sequential|batch progress~batch/cancel|partial failure~failure/checkpoint|idempotence~idempot
Batch completion مش معناه كل external side effect حصل مرة واحدة.
Unique jobs and overlapping
What is the difference between preventing duplicate job dispatch and preventing concurrent processing?
Unique job lock بيحد من enqueue حسب configuration؛ WithoutOverlapping بيحمي وقت processing. محتاج shared cache store وlock lifetime مناسب، وبرضه idempotency أساسية.

Unique-job mechanisms limit duplicate dispatch using a unique identity; overlapping middleware coordinates execution locks. Choose the appropriate phase, use a shared lock store and sensible expiry/release behavior, and design persistent idempotency for side effects. Test crashes, lock expiration and multiple workers.
dispatch vs execute~dispatch/process|shared store~shared/cache|expiry~expir/lock|idempotent test~idempot/test
Distributed lock لوحده مش exactly-once guarantee، خصوصًا بعد expiry أو crash.
Broadcast channel authorization
How do you broadcast order updates without exposing another customer’s events?
Public channel أي حد ممكن يشوفه؛ private/presence channels محتاجة authorization للـsubscription، مع payload minimal وtenant scoping.

Use private channels scoped to the order/user/tenant and authorize subscriptions using current resource permissions. Broadcast only necessary fields, exclude secrets and avoid relying on unpredictable channel names. Test unauthorized subscriptions and permission changes, and align event dispatch with committed state.
private channel~private|subscription auth~authoriz/subscri|minimal payload~payload/minimal|commit and tests~test/commit
Channel name فيه UUID مش بديل عن channel authorization.
Transaction and dispatch timing
A queued listener cannot find a newly created order. Why does afterCommit help and what does it not guarantee?
Worker ممكن يسبق transaction commit. afterCommit بيأخر dispatch لحد النجاح، لكن فيه crash window بين DB commit وإرسال message للـqueue حسب التصميم.

Dispatch after commit so workers see committed records and rolled-back work is not enqueued. Keep handlers idempotent. For guaranteed eventual dispatch, write an outbox record in the same transaction and deliver it with retries; test rollback and the commit-to-enqueue failure window.
timing~commit|rollback~rollback|outbox~outbox|idempotent tests~idempot/test
afterCommit مش بديل للـoutbox لما delivery durability مطلوبة.
Queue deployment safety
What happens if new code changes a job class while old workers and queued payloads still exist?
Jobs القديمة ممكن تفضل في queue بعد نشر version جديدة. لازم payload compatibility وgraceful worker restart وخطة rollback واعية بالـschema.

Keep job payloads backward compatible across rolling releases or version jobs deliberately. Restart workers gracefully, allow in-flight work to finish within timeouts and coordinate database migrations with old/new code compatibility. Test old payloads against the new release and monitor failures before removing legacy handlers.
compatibility~compatib/version|graceful restart~graceful/restart|schema rollout~schema/migrat|old payload test~test/payload
تغيير اسم job class فجأة ممكن يكسّر deserialization للـjobs اللي مستنية.

tracks.title: Laravel Cache & Sessions
rows: Cache keys and tenants
A cache key uses product:42 but product 42 has different visibility per tenant. What is the risk?
Cache key لازم يعكس كل dimensions المؤثرة في النتيجة: tenant، locale، permission أو user لو لازم. Cache leak ممكن يبقى security issue مش مجرد stale data.

Include tenant and any relevant visibility/locale/version dimensions in the key. Cache only appropriately shareable values, enforce authorization before serving them and define invalidation on changes. Test tenant isolation and avoid using unbounded raw request values as keys without normalization and limits.
key dimensions~tenant/locale|visibility auth~authoriz/visib|invalidation~invalidat|isolation tests~test/isolation
Caching authorized response globally ممكن يسرّب بيانات حتى لو query الأصلية كانت scoped صح.
Redis eviction
What can go wrong if cache entries, sessions and critical locks share one eviction-prone Redis instance?
Eviction policy ممكن تمسح keys تحت memory pressure. فقد cache شيء، وفقد session أو lock critical شيء تاني؛ لازم failure model وتشغيل مناسب.

Separate or configure workloads according to durability and eviction requirements. Monitor memory and evictions, set appropriate TTLs and capacity, and do not use disposable cache as the sole source of truth. Design lock-loss and session-loss behavior, test failure modes and consider separate instances for stronger isolation.
eviction behavior~evict|workload isolation~separate/isola|monitor capacity~memory/monitor|source of truth~truth/database
Redis logical databases لوحدها مش memory أو eviction isolation قوية.
Cache stampede
A hot cache entry expires while 2,000 requests arrive. How do you prevent all of them querying the DB?
Stampede محتاج coordination أو stale strategy. Locks لازم expiry مناسب وdouble-check بعد الحصول على lock؛ stale data مينفعش لكل domain.

Use a bounded regeneration lock with a second cache check, or stale-while-revalidate when stale results are acceptable. Add TTL jitter and protect the database with timeouts/admission limits. Define fallback when locking or regeneration fails and measure database load under synchronized expiry.
regeneration lock~lock|stale strategy~stale|TTL jitter~jitter|failure and load tests~test/fallback
Lock من غير timeout أو fallback ممكن يحوّل الـstampede لـrequests معلقة.
Concurrent sessions
Two requests update the same session cart simultaneously. How might data be lost?
Session store مش معناها كل read-modify-write atomic. ممكن request يكتب snapshot قديم فوق التاني؛ فكّر في session blocking أو cart storage بمعاملات.

Avoid uncoordinated session read-modify-write. Use supported session blocking with a shared locking driver where appropriate, or persist cart items with atomic database operations and version checks. Keep locks short, verify driver support and test two simultaneous requests and lock expiry.
lost update~lost/overwrite|blocking~block/lock|database alternative~database/atomic|concurrency tests~test/concurrent
حطّ cart مهمة تجاريًا في storage ليه consistency policy، مش افتراض إن session request لوحده هيحميها.
Cache invalidation after rollback
An update clears product cache before its DB transaction rolls back. Is that always safe? What about repopulation races?
Early invalidation ممكن يسمح لطلب تاني يرجّع old data للـcache قبل commit. بعد commit invalidation أو key versioning يقلل المشكلة لكن لازم تفهم السباقات.

Invalidate after successful commit and consider versioned keys or a defined consistency strategy for concurrent readers. Avoid populating cache from uncommitted state. Analyze the stale-reader race, use suitable coordination where required and read authoritative data in critical flows; test rollback and concurrent repopulation.
after commit~commit|versioning~version|reader race~race/stale|critical authority~authoritative/test
Cache-aside مش strongly consistent لمجرد إنك عملت forget بعد update.
Session driver choice
When would database, Redis or cookie sessions be appropriate, and what limits matter?
اختيار session driver مرتبط بالـsize والـlatency والمشاركة بين instances والـsecurity. cookie sessions encrypted مش معناها تخزن أي كمية أو أسرار بلا حدود.

Use a shared server-side store for multi-instance sessions with suitable latency, capacity and expiration. Cookie sessions have browser size/transport limits and require careful key security. Compare operational cost, logout/revocation needs and failure behavior; set secure, HttpOnly and appropriate SameSite cookie attributes.
shared store~shared/redis/database|cookie limits~size/cookie|revocation~revok/logout|attributes~httponly/samesite
SameSite setting لازم يتناسب مع auth flow؛ مش قيمة واحدة مناسبة لكل cross-site integration.

tracks.title: Laravel Files, Mail & Localization
rows: Private storage downloads
An invoice PDF lives in storage. How do you expose a download safely without making the disk public?
Private file محتاج authorization قبل تقديمه. URL صعب التخمين أو signed link له expiry مش بديل عن سياسة واضحة للـaccess.

Store invoices on a private disk with non-user-controlled paths. Authorize access to the owning invoice and stream a response or issue a short-lived scoped download URL. Set appropriate headers, avoid path traversal and test cross-user access, expired links and missing files.
private disk~private|authorization~authoriz/policy|signed expiry~signed/expir|path tests~traversal/test
متحوّلش كل storage لـpublic عشان تحل مشكلة download واحدة.
Upload validation
A user uploads image.php with an image Content-Type. How do you validate and store it?
اسم الملف وContent-Type headers مش proof لنوع المحتوى. قيّد الحجم والنوع من inspection مناسب وخزن باسم generated برا executable paths.

Validate size and inspected content type, restrict supported formats and generate server-side filenames. Store outside executable directories on an appropriate disk, scan or re-encode where the threat model requires it, enforce quotas and test spoofed extensions, malformed files and oversized uploads.
content inspection~mime/content|generated path~generat/filename|non executable~executable/private|negative tests~test/quota
SVG ممكن يحتوي active content؛ دعمه محتاج sanitization وتقديم آمن.
Queued notifications
Should a notification failure roll back a completed checkout? Explain your delivery strategy.
الـemail غالبًا side effect بعد العملية الأساسية. الـbusiness transaction تكتمل، والرسالة تتحاول async مع retries ومراقبة، حسب requirements.

Commit checkout first and dispatch a queued notification after commit, using an outbox when durable delivery is required. Make notification effects idempotent where needed, define retry/failure visibility and avoid sending secrets in logs. Test the notification contract and separately test transport failure handling.
after commit~commit|queued delivery~queue|outbox retries~outbox/retry|testing transport~test/failure
Notification::fake بيختبر dispatch intent، مش فعالية SMTP أو template rendering لوحده.
Mail templates and localization
A queued email uses the worker’s default locale instead of the customer’s. How would you fix it?
Background worker ملوش request locale مضمون. ابعت أو persist customer locale وحدد timezone والـformatting صراحة، وبعدين رجّع scoped state بعد الشغل.

Carry or resolve an explicit recipient locale and use the notification/mail localization API. Format dates and money with the business/recipient timezone and currency, translate keys and fallbacks, and avoid leaking locale state across jobs. Render-test Arabic/English and missing translations.
explicit locale~locale|timezone currency~timezone/currency|state isolation~state/scoped|render tests~test/render
ترجمة الكلمات لوحدها مش localization كاملة؛ اتجاه النص والأرقام والتواريخ جزء منها.
Blade escaping and XSS
What is the security difference between {{ $name }} and {!! $html !!}? When is raw output acceptable?
Blade escaped output بيحمي من HTML injection في سياقه. Raw HTML لازم trusted أو sanitized بسياسة مناسبة؛ escaping نفسه بيعتمد على output context.

Use escaped Blade output for untrusted text. Raw directives bypass escaping and require trusted/sanitized HTML with a narrowly defined policy. Use appropriate JSON/script serialization rather than concatenation, and test stored/reflected payloads; CSP helps defense in depth but does not replace encoding.
escaped output~escap|raw trust~sanitiz/trusted|context encoding~context/json|XSS tests~test/xss
HTML escaping مش بالضرورة كفاية جوه JavaScript أو URL context.
Resource cleanup
An export generates temporary files and queued jobs may crash. How do you prevent storage from growing forever?
الـcleanup محتاج finally في التنفيذ العادي وscheduled sweep للـcrashes والـabandoned files. احتفظ بـmetadata وexpiry ومتخليش path اختيار المستخدم.

Use generated scoped paths, close streams in finally and track export status and expiry. Add a scheduled idempotent cleanup for orphaned/expired files and an object-storage lifecycle policy where appropriate. Coordinate active downloads and retention requirements, monitor storage growth and test failed exports.
finally cleanup~finally|expiry metadata~expir/status|scheduled sweep~schedule/lifecycle|failure test~test/monitor

tracks.title: Laravel Artisan & Scheduling
rows: Artisan command design
Design an Artisan command that backfills missing invoice numbers safely in production.
Command الإنتاج محتاجة dry-run، batches، checkpoints وexit codes مفهومة. إعادة تشغيلها لازم متفسدش بيانات خلصت.

Define validated arguments, dry-run and bounded batches; use a stable cursor and checkpoint. Make updates idempotent with database constraints, report progress and meaningful exit codes, and support graceful interruption. Test restart behavior and run with controlled production load and observability.
dry run~dry-run/dry run|batches checkpoint~batch/checkpoint|idempotent~idempot|exit and restart~exit/restart

Add a required column to a large busy table without breaking old code during a rolling release.

URL موقّع ممكن يفضل usable للي معاه اللينك حسب التصميم؛ وضّح ده بدل افتراض ownership.

Drain traffic before incompatible work, account for queue worker behavior in maintenance mode and expose no secrets in health responses. tracks.title: Testing & Quality
rows: Test boundaries
Choose unit, feature and integration tests for a checkout flow. What should each prove?
Unit تختبر domain rule مع dependencies متحكم فيها. Feature تختبر HTTP contract والـauth والـDB حسب setup. Integration تختبر boundary فعلي زي DB engine أو provider sandbox.

Unit-test pricing and state rules, feature-test validation/authorization and response contracts, and integration-test database constraints and provider adapters. Cover failures and retries as well as the happy path. Mock external boundaries deliberately and do not mistake a fully mocked feature test for end-to-end verification.
unit rules~unit|feature contract~feature|integration real~integration|failure cases~failure/retry
اسم test مش ضمان للـscope اللي اتاختبر؛ راجع boundaries الفعلية.
Factories and isolation
Your tests pass individually but fail as a suite. How do you investigate shared state?
Factories وRefreshDatabase بيساعدوا في isolation، لكن cache وstatic state والوقت والـfilesystem ممكن يفضلوا خارج DB rollback.

Look for order dependence in database fixtures, cache, static variables, environment, time and files. Use factories with explicit relevant state, isolate or reset external stores and freeze time where needed. Run in varied order and parallel safely, keeping assertions independent of incidental IDs or timestamps.
shared state~state/cache|factories~factory/factories|time isolation~time/freeze|order independence~order/parallel
RefreshDatabase مش reset لكل حاجة خارج الـdatabase.
HTTP fakes
An adapter test uses Http::fake. What assertions make it useful, and what still needs a real integration test?
Fake يديك deterministic responses وتختبر payload وheaders وtimeout mapping. مش هيكتشف provider API غيّر behavior لو الـfake بتاعك قديم.

Fake success, error, timeout and malformed responses; assert URL, headers, body and call count without leaking credentials. Prevent stray requests. Keep a separate contract/sandbox integration check for provider compatibility and verify official docs; do not fake the adapter method under test.
request assertions~header/body|failure cases~timeout/error|no stray calls~stray/prevent|real contract check~sandbox/integration
الـfake اللي دايمًا بيرجع success مش بيختبر reliability.
Authorization matrix
How do you systematically test a multi-tenant invoice endpoint beyond one happy-path request?
اعمل matrix للـactors والـresources والـactions. Anonymous، owner، wrong tenant، revoked member، وadmin exceptions لازم كلهم يتجربوا حسب policy.

Create data-driven cases for unauthenticated, allowed, same-tenant denied, cross-tenant and revoked users. Test read/update/delete and alternate/bulk routes, assert response plus no unintended mutation, and verify private fields stay hidden. Keep policy unit tests and endpoint integration tests complementary.
actor matrix~matrix/unauth|tenant isolation~tenant|no mutation~mutation/database|all actions~delete/update
403 وحدها مش كفاية لو الـendpoint عدّل data قبل ما يرفض.
Concurrent tests
Why can an SQLite in-memory test pass while a MySQL stock race still exists? Design a meaningful test.
SQLite locking وSQL semantics تختلف عن MySQL/PostgreSQL. Race test محتاج requests/transactions مستقلة وتزامن متعمّد يفتح window السباق.

Use the production database engine with independent connections/processes. Synchronize requests near the contested read/write, assert stock and unique business outcomes after completion, and test retries/deadlocks. Keep deterministic coordination rather than relying only on random sleeps; an in-memory unit test cannot prove row-lock behavior.
production engine~mysql/postgres/production|independent connections~connection/process|synchronized race~synchron/barrier|invariant assertion~stock/invariant
Transaction wrapper للاختبار ممكن يخفي commit visibility اللي موجودة في الإنتاج.
Regression and test oracles
A bug fix test passes before the fix. What does that tell you? How do you improve it?
Regression test لازم يفشل على العيب القديم وينجح بعد الحل، وإلا غالبًا مش بيشغّل الـpath الصحيح أو assertion ضعيفة.

Reproduce the failing behavior independently, make the test fail against the old implementation and assert a user-visible invariant. Remove mocks that bypass the defect, include the boundary input and run the relevant integration path. Review for false positives and ensure the fix does not merely hard-code the fixture.
fail before fix~fail/before|independent expected~expected/invariant|correct boundary~boundary/mock|no hardcode~hard-code/hardcode
Coverage percentage عالي مش دليل إن assertions هتكشف defect.

questions.pitfall: الوقت المجمد مش اختبار للـscheduler infrastructure نفسها.

questions.question: How do you test that an orders endpoint avoids N+1 without a fragile millisecond assertion?

questions.model: Compare query behavior for one and many orders with related data, asserting bounded query growth rather than exact wall-clock milliseconds. Test selected fields and pagination, inspect peak memory where appropriate and keep a separate representative benchmark for latency. Avoid tests that pass because no relationships exist.
questions.pitfall: assert query count لازم يعكس behavior مهم، مش يثبت implementation details غير ضرورية.

tracks.title: HTTP & Networking Fundamentals
rows: Browser-to-server journey
Trace an HTTPS API call from a browser, including DNS, connection setup, proxy and application handling.
قبل Laravel فيه DNS وconnection وTLS وHTTP routing. فهم الطبقات بيساعد تحدد هل timeout سببه network ولا reverse proxy ولا application.

Resolve DNS, establish a connection and TLS with certificate validation, then send HTTP through any reverse proxy/load balancer to the app. The app validates/authenticates, queries dependencies and returns a response. Reused connections change setup costs; measure each phase and propagate a request ID across layers.
DNS~dns|TLS validation~tls/certificate|proxy app~proxy/load balanc|timing tracing~trace/request id/measure
TLS بيحمي النقل للـpeer الموثوق؛ مش بيصلّح authorization أو application vulnerabilities.
CORS and CSRF
Explain why CORS does not prevent all CSRF, and how cookie-based auth changes the threat.
CORS بيتحكم في browser access للـresponses وبعض requests، بينما CSRF يستغل credentials اللي browser بيبعتها تلقائيًا. محتاج CSRF protection مناسب وcookie policy.

CORS is a browser cross-origin access policy, not an authorization boundary or universal request blocker. Cookie-authenticated state-changing requests need CSRF defenses, correct SameSite settings and origin checks as appropriate. Configure exact trusted origins and credentials carefully; test preflight and actual requests without treating CORS as API security.
CORS purpose~browser/origin|ambient cookies~cookie|CSRF defense~csrf|configuration tests~test/preflight
Simple cross-origin request ممكن يتبعت حتى لو JavaScript مش مسموح له يقرا الرد.
Timeout budgets
A request calls three services and each gets a 30-second timeout. What is wrong with that design?
الـend-to-end deadline لازم يوزّع budget على calls وretries. Timeouts لكل طبقة لوحدها ممكن تتراكم وتفضل servers ماسكة resources بعد client ما مشي.

Start from an end-to-end deadline, allocate connection/read budgets and cap retries inside it. Parallelize independent calls when safe, cancel or abandon work appropriately and use fallback/circuit-breaking where justified. Observe upstream and proxy timeouts and test latency spikes; increasing timeouts is not a capacity fix.
deadline budget~deadline/budget|bounded retries~retry/retries|parallel fallback~parallel/fallback|observability~proxy/monitor
Retries لعمليات state-changing محتاجة idempotency، مش مجرد timeout أطول.
Cookies and tokens
Compare HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite cookie attributes. Which threats does each address?
كل attribute ليها دور: Secure للنقل عبر HTTPS، HttpOnly يمنع JS من قراءة cookie، SameSite يقيّد إرسالها cross-site. مفيش واحدة بتحمي من كل XSS/CSRF لوحدها.

Secure restricts cookie transport to secure contexts, HttpOnly blocks direct script access and SameSite limits cross-site sending according to mode. Configure domain/path and expiry deliberately, regenerate sessions on login and combine with CSRF protection and XSS prevention. Test the actual deployment origin relationships.
Secure~secure|HttpOnly~httponly|SameSite~samesite|layered defenses~csrf/xss
HttpOnly مش بيمنع XSS من تنفيذ authenticated actions في نفس الصفحة.
HTTP caching
How do ETag, Cache-Control and Vary affect a personalized GET endpoint?
HTTP caching غير Redis application cache. Private responses محتاجة directives تمنع shared cache leakage، وVary لازم يعكس headers المؤثرة من غير اعتماد أعمى عليه لحماية data.

Use explicit private/no-store policy where appropriate for sensitive responses. ETag enables conditional validation with If-None-Match and 304 semantics; Vary describes request-header dimensions affecting representation. Avoid caching authenticated personalized data in shared caches without a deliberate design and test authorization, cache keys and invalidation.
cache policy~private/no-store|conditional ETag~etag/304|Vary~vary|personal isolation~personal/auth
no-cache معناه لازم revalidation، مش بالضرورة منع تخزين الـresponse.
WebSocket versus polling
For order status updates, compare polling, SSE and WebSockets and justify a simple starting point.
Realtime مش لازم WebSocket دايمًا. Polling سهل، SSE server-to-client stream، وWebSocket اتصال bidirectional؛ كل اختيار له capacity وreconnect/auth implications.

Use modest polling for low-frequency updates if latency requirements allow. SSE fits one-way event streams; WebSockets fit interactive bidirectional traffic. Define authentication, reconnection, missed-event recovery and connection capacity, measure cost and avoid claiming exactly-once delivery from the transport.
polling tradeoff~poll|SSE one way~sse|WebSocket bidirectional~websocket/bidirect|recovery auth~reconnect/auth
Realtime transport مش بديل عن durable state؛ بعد reconnect ارجع للمصدر الموثوق.

tracks.title: SQL & Data Modeling
rows: Schema invariants
Design order_items so invalid quantities and duplicate product lines cannot slip through concurrent requests.
Validation في التطبيق مهم لكن constraints بتحمي كل write paths. عرّف duplicate line حسب الـdomain: product بس ولا variant/options كمان.

Use appropriate foreign keys, non-null types and an engine-supported positive-quantity constraint. Define a unique key for the intended order-line identity, choose exact money storage and retain immutable unit-price snapshots. Validate in the app too and handle constraint failures under concurrent writes.
foreign keys~foreign|positive quantity~check/positive|unique line~unique|money snapshot~price/snapshot
Constraint غلط ممكن يمنع valid variants أو يسمح duplicates حسب تعريف line identity.
Normalization versus snapshots
Should an old invoice show the customer’s new address? Explain normalization and historical snapshots.
Normalization بتقلل update anomalies، لكن historical facts زي invoice address/unit price لازم تتثبت حسب المتطلبات بدل join دايم على current state.

Normalize current customer and product entities for consistency, but snapshot the billing address, description and accepted prices needed by the historical invoice. Define immutable facts and correction policy, avoid accidental updates through joins and test that later profile/catalog edits do not rewrite history.
normalization~normaliz|historical snapshot~snapshot|immutable facts~immutable/history|test later edits~test/update
Denormalization لازم تبقى intentional مع ownership وconsistency policy.
LEFT JOIN pitfalls
A LEFT JOIN query filters right_table.status in WHERE and loses unmatched rows. Why?
WHERE بيشتغل على نتيجة الـjoin؛ شرط على right column يستبعد NULL unmatched rows. حط شروط المطابقة في ON لو عايز تحافظ على الصفوف الشمال حسب الهدف.

WHERE right.status = ... rejects unmatched rows because NULL does not satisfy that predicate, effectively changing the result. Move the intended right-side match condition into ON when unmatched left rows must remain, and test matched, unmatched and null-status cases.
NULL semantics~null|WHERE effect~where|ON condition~on/join|cases tests~test/unmatched
نقل أي شرط من WHERE لـON من غير فهم المطلوب ممكن يغيّر المعنى بشكل مختلف.
Aggregate correctness
A join from orders to items and payments doubles the sales total. How do you diagnose and fix it?
Joining اتنين one-to-many relations بيعمل fan-out؛ aggregate ممكن يعد القيمة أكتر من مرة. حدّد grain قبل sum واجمع كل relation عند grain مناسب.

Inspect cardinalities and define the result grain. Pre-aggregate items and payments by order in separate subqueries/CTEs before joining, or use separate targeted queries. Validate totals against independent fixtures with multiple children; SUM(DISTINCT amount) can wrongly collapse equal legitimate amounts.
fanout~fan/cardinal|grain~grain/order|preaggregate~aggregate/subquer/cte|distinct warning~distinct
DISTINCT مش حل عام للتكرار الناتج عن join؛ ممكن يخفي records صحيحة.
SQL injection boundaries
Are prepared statements sufficient if the client controls a table name or raw ORDER BY clause?
Parameters بتحمي values، مش arbitrary SQL structure. Identifiers/operators لازم يتحددوا من allowlist في code، وDB account له least privilege.

Bind all values and map user-facing sort/filter choices to fixed known identifiers and operators. Never concatenate raw user SQL fragments. Restrict database privileges, limit query cost and test malicious payloads; prepared statements do not parameterize arbitrary table names or SQL syntax.
bound values~bind/parameter|identifier allowlist~allowlist|least privilege~privilege|malicious tests~test
Escaping يدوي لكل input مش بديل موثوق عن query design سليم.
Transactions and external effects
Why can a DB rollback not undo an email or third-party charge? How do you coordinate them?
DB transaction بتتحكم في participating DB work، مش كل العالم الخارجي. الحل workflow واضح وoutbox أو compensating actions حسب العملية.

Keep local invariants in one short transaction and publish durable intent via an outbox when required. Execute external effects idempotently with retries and reconciliation; use compensating actions for multi-step workflows rather than pretending rollback can reverse a sent email or captured payment.
local scope~local/transaction|outbox~outbox|idempotent retries~idempot|compensation~compensat/reconcil
متمسكش DB row lock وانت مستني network call طويل عشان تحاول تعمل atomicity وهمية.

questions.question: Why is a read replica not a sufficient backup? Define RPO, RTO and a useful restore test.
questions.lesson: Replication ممكن تنقل accidental deletes أو corruption. Backup محتاج snapshots/log retention وصلاحيات منفصلة حسب المتطلبات، وأهم حاجة restore فعلي متجرب.

questions.title: Window functions
questions.question: Return the newest record per customer while retaining all columns. Explain ROW_NUMBER and deterministic tie-breaking.

questions.pitfall: اسم alias للـwindow مش متاح كشرط WHERE في نفس SELECT على معظم المحركات المعتادة.

questions.title: Foreign key deletion policy
questions.question: Should deleting a customer cascade into paid orders? How do you decide between restrict, cascade and anonymization?
questions.lesson: FK action قرار domain وretention، مش default آلي. Historical financial records ممكن لازم تفضل مع تقليل personal data حسب السياسة المعتمدة.
questions.model: Use cascade only for truly dependent disposable data. questions.pitfall: Soft delete مش حذف فعلي ولا anonymization للـpersonal data.

tracks.title: Security for Backend Developers
rows: SSRF in URL imports
An endpoint fetches a user-supplied URL to import an avatar. How could SSRF occur and how do you prevent it?
Server-side fetch ممكن يوصل internal services أو metadata endpoints. Validation محتاجة scheme/host/IP restrictions وسياسة redirects وDNS، مش regex بسيطة.

Prefer an allowlisted source or direct upload. Restrict schemes, destinations and ports; reject private/link-local addresses across DNS resolution and redirects, enforce outbound network policy and bound size/time. Use a hardened fetch path, validate content and test bypasses without accessing real internal secrets.
destination allowlist~allowlist|private IP redirects~private/redirect|network enforcement~egress/network|limits tests~test/timeout
فحص hostname قبل request وبعدين DNS يتغير ممكن يسمح بـDNS rebinding لو التنفيذ مش محمي.
Secrets rotation
A production API key is accidentally committed. Is deleting the file enough?
Secret اللي اتنشر لازم تعتبره compromised. احذف exposure ودوّر المفتاح وراجع الاستخدام؛ إزالة الـcommit مش بتلغي النسخ اللي اتاخدت.

Revoke/rotate the exposed credential promptly, update approved secret storage and deployed consumers, and inspect provider/audit logs for misuse. Remove exposure from source/history as appropriate without treating that as revocation. Add secret scanning, least privilege and a tested rotation procedure.
revoke rotate~revok/rotat|consumer update~deploy/consumer|audit review~audit/log|prevention~scan/privilege
متطبعش الـsecret في output التحقيق أو تضيفه في ticket عشان تشرح التسريب.
Command injection
A thumbnail endpoint concatenates a filename into a shell command. What is the safer design?
Shell string بتفتح باب metacharacters injection. الأفضل library API أو process API بarguments منفصلة، مع generated paths وقيود resource.

Prefer a vetted library API. If invoking a process, use an argument-array API without a shell, fixed executable and validated options/paths. Prevent option injection, use generated filenames, least-privileged execution and resource limits, and test malicious names without running destructive commands.
no shell~shell/library|argument array~argument/array|option/path control~option/path|least privilege limits~privilege/limit
escapeshellarg مش مبرر لقبول arbitrary executable أو options من المستخدم.
Logging sensitive data
What belongs in an error log for a failed payment request, and what must be excluded?
Log مفيد فيه correlation ID وprovider reference آمن وerror category. متسجلش PAN/CVV أو auth headers أو tokens أو payload حساس بالكامل.

Log a correlation ID, operation and sanitized error category/status with appropriate provider references. Redact credentials, payment data and unnecessary personal information, restrict log access and retention, and preserve enough context for reconciliation. Test redaction and avoid dumping raw request/exception objects indiscriminately.
correlation~correlation/request id|redaction~redact/sanitiz|access retention~retention/access|redaction tests~test
حتى exception message ممكن تحتوي URL فيها token؛ راجع integration error mapping.
Insecure deserialization
Why is unserialize on untrusted input dangerous? What would you use for a simple data exchange?
PHP object deserialization ممكن يفعل magic methods وسلاسل gadgets حسب dependencies. JSON data مع schema validation غالبًا أنسب للـplain data.

Do not unserialize untrusted input. Use JSON with strict shape/type validation for plain data and avoid treating it as executable behavior. If legacy data must be supported, migrate to a safe format with authenticated provenance and narrowly reviewed handling; allowed_classes is not a general guarantee of safety.
avoid unserialize~unserialize|JSON schema~json/schema|gadget risk~gadget/magic|migration trust~migrat/authentic
Input موجود في cookie أو queue message مش بالضرورة trusted لمجرد إنه جاي من infrastructure.
Threat modeling a feature
Before shipping a file-sharing API, what questions would you ask to identify security risks?
Threat model يبدأ assets وactors وtrust boundaries وabuse cases. اربط controls بالتهديدات واختبر enforcement مش مجرد checklist أسماء.

Identify sensitive assets, intended actors and trust boundaries, then enumerate unauthorized read/write, link leakage, malicious uploads and resource exhaustion. Define least-privilege access, validation, quotas and audit/retention requirements. Test abuse paths, document residual risk and plan revocation and incident response.
assets boundaries~asset/boundar|abuse cases~abuse/unauthoriz|controls~quota/privilege|tests response~test/incident
Security review خطوة مستمرة مع تغيّر feature والـdependencies، مش مرة واحدة قبل release.

tracks.title: Git, Debugging & Observability
rows: Debugging a 500
A production endpoint returns 500 only for some tenants. Walk through a disciplined investigation.
ابدأ بالـscope والـrequest ID والـrelease، واعمل reproduce آمن ببيانات sanitized. فرق بين symptoms وroot cause وقيس أثر أي mitigation.

Correlate failing requests with release, tenant, inputs and dependency traces without exposing secrets. Inspect structured exceptions and query/dependency timings, reproduce with sanitized fixtures and compare working/failing cases. Apply a minimal mitigation, add a regression test and verify error rate after release.
correlation~correlation/request id|safe reproduction~reproduc/sanitiz|minimal mitigation~mitigat/minimal|verification~test/metric
تشغيل APP_DEBUG للعامة عشان تشوف الـstack trace ممكن يسرّب config وpaths وsecrets.
Metrics versus logs versus traces
Which signals would you collect for a slow checkout and why are they complementary?
Metrics للاتجاهات والـalerts؛ logs للأحداث والـcontext؛ traces بتربط مراحل request عبر services. استخدم cardinality محسوبة عشان التكلفة.

Measure latency percentiles, error rate, throughput and saturation. Use structured logs with correlation IDs for specific failures and distributed traces for dependency timing. Track queue lag and payment outcomes, keep metric label cardinality bounded and alert on user impact rather than every exception.
metrics~metric/p95|logs~log/correlation|traces~trac|bounded labels~cardinal/label
User IDs كـmetric labels على نطاق واسع ممكن يعمل cardinality explosion.
Git revert versus reset
A bad commit is already on the shared main branch. How do you undo it safely?
Revert بيضيف commit عكسي من غير إعادة كتابة shared history. Reset مناسب لحالات محلية أو منسّقة بعناية، مش force push تلقائي لفرع الناس بتشتغل عليه.

Prefer git revert for a published shared commit, review the resulting diff and run relevant checks. Coordinate merge-commit reverts carefully, account for already-applied schema/data effects and deploy the validated correction. Use reset for appropriate local history changes without rewriting shared work unexpectedly.
revert~revert|shared history~shared/history|diff tests~diff/test|schema effect~schema/data
Git revert مش بيعمل rollback للـDB أو external actions اللي حصلت من الكود.
Code review
What do you look for in a Laravel PR beyond style and naming?
Review يركز على behavior وsecurity وdata integrity وfailure modes. Diff صغير وtests فيها evidence بيسهّلوا القرار، والأسلوب يتراجع بأدوات مناسبة.

Check requirements, authorization, validation, data constraints, transactions, query cost and failure/retry paths. Review migrations and deployment compatibility, meaningful tests and observability. Ask for a concrete example and trade-off rationale; avoid turning optional style preferences into blockers for unrelated code.
behavior requirements~requirement/behavior|security integrity~authoriz/constraint|performance failures~query/retry|tests rollout~test/deploy
Passing CI مش ضمان إن الـrequirements نفسها اتنفذت صح.
Incident mitigation
Error rates spike after deployment. How do you choose rollback versus a forward fix?
الهدف الأول تقليل أثر المستخدم، وبعده التحقيق. Rollback آمن لو schema/data compatibility تسمح؛ أحيانًا feature flag أو forward fix أفضل.

Assess user impact and correlate with the release, then use a safe rollback or feature disablement if compatibility permits. Preserve evidence, avoid destructive database reversal, communicate status and monitor recovery. Follow with root-cause analysis, a regression test and preventive action; prefer reversible mitigations under uncertainty.
impact first~impact|safe rollback~rollback/compatib|evidence monitor~evidence/monitor|followup test~test/root
متعملش rollback migration بيمسح data مهمة تحت ضغط incident من غير فهم الأثر.
Linux and process basics
A Laravel job fails writing storage files on Linux. What do you check before using chmod 777?
Permissions محتاجة owner/group مناسبين للـweb والـworker users، وممكن المشكلة disk full أو path أو mount. 777 بيوسع access بلا داعي.

Inspect the actual process user/group, path ownership, directory traversal permissions, writable storage/cache paths and disk/inode capacity. Apply least-privilege ownership/modes and deployment consistency, check relevant logs and test both web and queue contexts. Do not solve the problem with world-writable permissions.
user ownership~user/owner|directory permissions~permission|disk capacity~disk/inode|least privilege~privilege/777
تشغيل web worker كـroot عشان يكتب files حل خطر ومش علاج للـpermissions.

questions.lesson: الهدف الأول تقليل أثر المستخدم، وبعده التحقيق. Rollback آمن لو schema/data compatibility تسمح؛ أحيانًا feature flag أو forward fix أفضل.
questions.model: Assess user impact and correlate with the release, then use a safe rollback or feature disablement if compatibility permits. Preserve evidence, avoid destructive database reversal, communicate status and monitor recovery. Follow with root-cause analysis, a regression test and preventive action; prefer reversible mitigations under uncertainty.
questions.pitfall: متعملش rollback migration بيمسح data مهمة تحت ضغط incident من غير فهم الأثر.

questions.title: Linux and process basics
questions.question: A Laravel job fails writing storage files on Linux. What do you check before using chmod 777?
questions.lesson: Permissions محتاجة owner/group مناسبين للـweb والـworker users، وممكن المشكلة disk full أو path أو mount. 777 بيوسع access بلا داعي.
questions.model: Inspect the actual process user/group, path ownership, directory traversal permissions, writable storage/cache paths and disk/inode capacity. Apply least-privilege ownership/modes and deployment consistency, check relevant logs and test both web and queue contexts. Do not solve the problem with world-writable permissions.
questions.pitfall: تشغيل web worker كـroot عشان يكتب files حل خطر ومش علاج للـpermissions.

questions.title: Merge, rebase and conflicts
questions.question: Compare merge and rebase on a feature branch. How do you resolve a conflict without losing either behavior?
questions.lesson: Merge بيحافظ على branch history، rebase بيعيد تشغيل commits على base جديدة وبيغيّر hashes. حل conflict محتاج فهم intent من الطرفين واختبار النتيجة.
questions.model: Use merge to preserve shared history or rebase appropriate local feature history for a linear sequence. Avoid rewriting shared commits without coordination. Inspect both changes and surrounding behavior, resolve deliberately, review the final diff and run relevant tests before continuing or pushing.
questions.pitfall: اختيار ours/theirs لكل files عشان يختفي conflict مش حل تقني للـbehavior.

tracks.title: Data Structures & Big O
tracks.desc: Hash maps، Stacks، Queues، Trees، وGraphs
rows: Complexity analysis
A PHP loop calls in_array on a growing list for every input item. What is the complexity and a better structure?
Loop فوق n ومعاها linear lookup ممكن توصل O(n²). Hash set مناسب لـmembership غالبًا average O(1)، مقابل مساحة O(n). PHP array ليها memory overhead كبير.

Repeated linear membership checks over a growing list give O(n²) time. Use a hash set with normalized keys for average O(n) total time and O(n) extra space. Define strict value identity and account for PHP key coercion, memory overhead and adversarial worst-case assumptions.
quadratic~o(n²)/o(n^2)/quadratic|hash set~hash/set|space tradeoff~space/o(n)|PHP identity~key/coercion
Big O مش قياس latency وحده؛ constants والـmemory بيبانوا جدًا في PHP arrays.
Stack versus queue
Choose structures for undo history, BFS and background job ordering. Explain operation costs in PHP.
Stack=LIFO وQueue=FIFO. array_shift ممكن يكلّف مع lists كبيرة؛ SplQueue أو head index بيجنب shift المتكرر حسب الاستخدام.

Use a stack for undo and a queue for BFS. Use SplQueue or a head index for repeated dequeue operations instead of repeatedly shifting large arrays. A distributed job queue has persistence/retry/concurrency semantics beyond an in-memory FIFO; define ordering expectations explicitly.
LIFO~lifo/stack|FIFO~fifo/queue|efficient dequeue~splqueue/head|distributed distinction~retry/persist
مع أكتر من worker، dequeue order مش ضمان completion order.
Binary search requirements
When is binary search valid and what common boundary bug can cause an infinite loop?
لازم sorted data أو monotonic predicate. حافظ على interval invariant وحدّث low/high عشان النطاق يصغر؛ عرّف inclusive/exclusive boundaries.

Binary search requires a sorted sequence or monotonic predicate. Maintain a clear interval invariant, compute mid safely and shrink the interval every iteration. Define the not-found result and duplicate policy, test empty/singleton/boundary cases, and distinguish O(log n) search from any prior sorting cost.
sorted monotonic~sort/monotonic|interval invariant~invariant/interval|shrinking~shrink/low/high|boundary tests~test/empty
فرز كل request عشان تعمل binary search مرة واحدة ممكن يبقى أغلى من linear scan.
Heap for top K
Find the top 10 most frequent API endpoints from a large stream. What structures and trade-offs do you choose?
Count map محتاجة مساحة بعدد distinct keys؛ min-heap بحجم K بتختار top K من counts بكفاءة. Exact counting مش constant memory لو cardinality مش bounded.

Count frequencies in a map, then maintain a min-heap of size K over U distinct keys for O(n + U log K) time and O(U + K) space. Define tie ordering. For unbounded cardinality, use external aggregation or an explicitly approximate algorithm with documented error bounds.
frequency map~map/count|min heap~heap|complexity~log/o(n|unbounded caveat~approx/unbound
Heap بحجم K لوحده مش بيخزن exact frequencies لكل stream غير محدود.
Graph traversal
A dependency graph may contain cycles. Compare BFS and DFS and how you prevent infinite traversal.
BFS بيستخدم queue وDFS stack/recursion. visited set بيمنع إعادة الزيارة؛ directed cycle detection محتاج visiting states أو indegree approach مش مجرد visited لوحده.

Represent vertices and edges with adjacency lists and track visited nodes for reachability, giving O(V+E) time. BFS finds shortest paths in unweighted graphs; DFS suits depth exploration. Detect directed cycles with active/finished states or topological processing, and test disconnected components and self-loops.
adjacency visited~adjacen/visited|BFS shortest~bfs/unweighted|cycle state~active/indegree|complexity~o(v+e)/o(v + e)
DFS recursion على graph عميق ممكن يعمل stack pressure؛ iterative traversal بديل عملي.
Choosing storage structures
When would a hash map, sorted array or database index be the right choice for backend lookups?
الاختيار مرتبط بعدد lookups، updates، memory، persistence، ونوع query. In-memory hash map مش بديل لـDB index لبيانات أكبر من RAM أو متعددة processes.

Use a hash map for repeated exact lookups over bounded in-memory data, a sorted array for ordered/range access with infrequent changes, and a database index for persistent shared queries. Compare construction/update costs, key semantics and memory, and benchmark with representative workloads rather than only asymptotic labels.
exact lookup~hash/exact|ordered range~sort/range|persistent shared~database/persist|workload cost~benchmark/memory
O(1) average lookup مش معناه map من مليون PHP entries أرخص من indexed query في كل حالة.

questions.title: Tree traversal and recursion
questions.question: Traverse a binary tree in-order. Explain the base case, call-stack cost and when an iterative stack is safer.
questions.lesson: In-order: left، node، right. لازم base case للـnull. Complexity في الوقت O(n)، ومساحة recursion O(h) حسب ارتفاع الشجرة؛ chain طويلة ممكن توصل O(n).
questions.model: Return on a null node, traverse left, visit the node and traverse right. Time O(n), auxiliary stack O(h); a skewed tree has height n. Use an explicit stack for depth limits, validate whether the input is truly a tree and test empty, singleton and skewed shapes.
questions.pitfall: Tree-like data ممكن يبقى فيه cycle لو refs غير مضمونة؛ recursion لوحدها مش graph traversal آمن.

questions.title: Linked-list cycle detection
questions.question: Detect a cycle in a singly linked list with O(1) extra space. Why do slow and fast pointers meet?
questions.lesson: Floyd algorithm بيحرّك slow خطوة وfast خطوتين. لو فيه cycle، فرق مواقعهم جوه الدورة بيتغير لحد ما يتقابلوا؛ لو fast وصل null مفيش cycle.
questions.model: Advance slow by one and fast by two while fast and its next node exist. Compare node identity, not stored value; a meeting implies a cycle. Time O(n), space O(1). Test empty lists, self-loops and repeated values without a cycle; avoid dereferencing null.
questions.pitfall: تساوي values بتاعة nodeين مش معناه إنهم نفس node أو فيه cycle.

tracks.title: Laravel Advanced Essentials
rows: Custom validation rules
A tax identifier needs country-specific checks and an optional external verification. How do you structure validation?
Local deterministic rule تختلف عن expensive external verification. خليك واضح هل external check blocking requirement ولا async status، واعزل provider failures عن invalid input.

Use a custom rule or validator for deterministic format/checksum rules with explicit country context. Put external verification behind an adapter with timeouts and a defined pending/failure policy, potentially async. Test malformed IDs, provider outage and locale messages without performing live calls in unit tests.
local rule~rule/checksum|external boundary~adapter/external|failure policy~pending/timeout|tests~test
تعطّل provider مش معناه إن كل tax IDs بقت invalid.
Package evaluation
You need roles and permissions. How do you evaluate using a Laravel package versus building the feature?
راجع fit للـdomain، compatibility، maintenance/security/license، migration path، وتأثير caching وmulti-tenancy. Package مشهور مش إعفاء من فهم السلوك.

Compare requirements against package capabilities, supported framework/PHP versions, maintenance, security history and license. Prototype tenant isolation and permission caching, review schema/upgrade costs and test critical authorization behavior. Choose the smallest maintainable solution and document how to replace or migrate it if necessary.
fit versions~version/requirement|maintenance security~mainten/security|tenant tests~tenant/test|migration exit~migrat/replace
Package بيقدّم primitives؛ policies وdomain rules بتفضل مسؤوليتك.
Search integration
SQL LIKE is slow and relevance is poor. How would you evaluate adding a search engine or Scout integration?
Search engine بيفتح indexing pipeline وeventual consistency وoperational cost. عرّف relevance وfilters والـsecurity قبل اختيار الأداة.

Measure current query behavior and relevance requirements. Evaluate a supported search adapter, define indexed fields and tenant filters, and build reliable reindex/update/delete workflows. Keep the database authoritative, handle index lag and test permission changes, ranking and recovery. Avoid indexing secrets or assuming results are currently authorized.
requirements measure~measure/relevan|tenant filters~tenant/filter|index lifecycle~reindex/delete|lag authority~lag/authoritative
Search result ID لازم يتراجع access بتاعه حسب freshness requirements؛ stale index ممكن يكشف metadata.
HTTP client resilience
How do you wrap Laravel’s HTTP client for a provider with strict rate limits and occasional malformed responses?
HTTP facade أداة نقل؛ adapter يعرّف contract ويترجم error categories. لازم timeouts وحدود retries وschema validation وobservability.

Use an adapter with connection/request deadlines, validated response shape and domain error mapping. Handle rate limits and Retry-After, retry only transient failures within a budget and use idempotency for writes. Redact logs, fake HTTP in tests and retain a separate provider contract check.
timeout budget~timeout/deadline|schema mapping~schema/error|rate retry~429/retry|tests redaction~test/redact
نجاح HTTP 200 مش ضمان إن provider body فيه data صالحة.
Pipeline and middleware ordering
Why can middleware order change authentication, locale or tenant resolution behavior?
كل middleware بيبني context للي بعده وممكن يغيّر response في الرجوع. ترتيب tenant resolution وauth والـbindings لازم يبقى صريح ومختبَر.

Define dependencies between middleware, such as authentication before user-derived tenant context and context before scoped resource resolution. Use the framework’s supported priority/configuration mechanism, avoid mutating global state and test both request and response phases, including unauthenticated and missing-tenant paths.
ordering dependencies~order/before|tenant context~tenant/context|supported config~priority/config|pipeline tests~test/response
tenant ID من header مش موثوق من غير ربطه بعضوية المستخدم.
Modular Laravel design
Organize a growing CRM with leads, billing and notifications without one giant Services folder.
قسّم حسب business capabilities وخلي dependencies واتجاهاتها واضحة. Shared code لازم يبقى فعليًا مشترك، ومش كل model يستاهل microservice.

Group code by cohesive business capabilities with explicit application actions and contracts at boundaries. Keep controllers thin, domain rules testable and shared primitives small; define transaction/data ownership and avoid cyclic module dependencies. Start in one deployable app and extract only when operational needs justify it.
capability modules~capabil/module|explicit boundary~contract/boundar|data ownership~ownership/transaction|avoid cycles~cycl/test
Folder structure لوحدها مش architecture لو كل modules بتكتب في data بعض من غير rules.

tracks.title: Problem Solving with PHP
tracks.desc: تحدّيات بـinputs/outputs وحلول PHP وBig O
rows: Two Sum with stable indices

Implement twoSum(array $nums, int $target): ?array in PHP. Return distinct original indices, or null.
Input: [2,7,11,15], 9 → [0,1]
Input: [3,3], 6 → [0,1]
Input: [1,2], 8 → null
Assume integer values and representable complements; explain the one-pass invariant.
فكّر في complement: قبل ما تضيف العنصر الحالي، دوّر على target-current في الـmap. كده متستخدمش نفس index مرتين، وتتعامل مع duplicates صح.

Maintain a map from previously seen value to its index. Before insertion, look for target minus the current value and return the pair. This preserves distinct indices, handles duplicate values and takes average O(n) time and O(n) space. Define integer bounds and test negative values and no solution.
previous values map~map/seen|lookup before insert~before/complement|time and space~o(n)|duplicates tests~duplicate/test
لو ضفت current قبل lookup ممكن ترجع نفس العنصر مرتين لما target=2*current.
First non-repeating ASCII byte

Return the index of the first unique byte in an ASCII string, or -1.
"swiss" → 1
"aabb" → -1
"" → -1
How would your contract change for Unicode grapheme clusters?
حلّها بتمريرتين: عدّ frequency، وبعدها امشي بنفس الترتيب لأول count=1. السؤال ASCII مقصود عشان byte indexing يبقى صحيح.

Count byte frequencies, then scan from the start for the first count of one. Time O(n), space O(min(n, alphabet size)), bounded by the ASCII alphabet here. An index must be defined as byte, code point or grapheme for Unicode; this implementation does not solve grapheme segmentation.
frequency count~count/frequenc|preserve order~scan/first|complexity~o(n)|ASCII Unicode boundary~ascii/unicode
str_split وstrlen بيتعاملوا مع bytes، مش user-perceived characters.
Balanced brackets

Validate a string containing only ()[]{}; reject other characters.
"([]){}" → true
"([)]" → false
"" → true
Explain the stack invariant and complexity.
الـstack بيحتفظ بالـopening brackets اللي لسه متقفلتش. كل closing لازم يطابق آخر opening بالترتيب، وفي النهاية stack فاضي.

Push opening brackets. For each closing bracket, pop and require the matching opener; reject unknown characters or an empty stack. Accept only if the stack is empty at the end. Time O(n), worst-case extra space O(n). Test unmatched openings, early closings and crossed nesting.
stack LIFO~stack/lifo|matching order~match/pop|empty at end~empty|complexity tests~o(n)/test
تساوي عدد openings وclosings مش كفاية لإثبات صحة nesting.
Longest substring without repeats

Return the maximum length of a substring without repeated ASCII bytes.
"abcabcbb" → 3
"bbbbb" → 1
"abba" → 2
"" → 0
Do not enumerate all substrings.
Sliding window بتتحرك حدودها لقدّام بس. خزّن آخر index لكل byte، ولما يتكرر جوه النافذة حرّك left بعده من غير ما ترجع left لورا.

Track the last index of each byte and a left boundary. On a repeated byte, set left to max(left, lastIndex+1), then update the best window length. The boundary never moves backward. Average O(n) time, O(alphabet size) space; abba catches the common backward-boundary bug.
sliding window~window|last index map~last/map|monotonic left~max/never|complexity~o(n)
left = last+1 من غير max ممكن يوسّع window غلط مع "abba".
Lower-bound binary search

Implement lowerBound for a sorted integer list. Return the first index whose value is >= target, or count($nums).
[1,2,2,4], 2 → 1
[1,2,2,4], 3 → 3
[], 5 → 0
[1,2], 9 → 2
استعمل half-open interval [low, high). كل خطوة تقلص النطاق، والإجابة ممكن تكون n لو مفيش value مناسبة. ده بيبسط empty input وduplicates.

Maintain [low, high) as the candidate interval. If nums[mid] is below target, move low to mid+1; otherwise move high to mid. At convergence low is the first qualifying index, possibly n. Time O(log n), space O(1); requires an already sorted dense list.
half-open invariant~interval/half-open|shrink branches~mid/low/high|duplicates end~first/duplicate|complexity~log
الـsolution مفترض dense list من index0؛ PHP associative array مش نفس contract.
Merge overlapping intervals

Merge valid closed integer intervals; touching endpoints count as overlap.
[[1,3],[2,6],[8,10],[10,12]] → [[1,6],[8,12]]
[] → []
[[1,4],[2,3]] → [[1,4]]
Explain sort cost and whether input is mutated.
رتّب حسب start، واحتفظ بآخر interval مدموج. لو next.start <= last.end ادمجهم، وإلا ابدأ interval جديدة. حدّد closed ولا half-open عشان touching endpoints.

Sort by start then end and scan once, extending the last merged end when intervals overlap. Time O(n log n), output space O(n), with sort implementation overhead separate. This function works on a local array value. Validate interval shape/order at the boundary; half-open interval semantics would change the overlap condition.
sort start~sort|merge max~max/end|boundary semantics~closed/touch|complexity~log
استخدام < بدل <= بيغيّر معنى تداخل endpoints؛ الاختيار لازم يمشي مع contract.
Count subarrays with a target sum

Count contiguous subarrays whose sum equals k; negative integers are allowed.
[1,1,1], 2 → 2
[1,-1,0], 0 → 3
[], 0 → 0
Assume all intermediate integer arithmetic is representable.
